The product has been withdrawn from sale.
I haven't made a sale all week.
She gets 10 per cent commission on each sale.
They charge a fee of 3 to 5 per cent of the sale price .
We gave them our sales pitch (= our explanation of why they should buy something).

senses.definition_vi: một hành động hoặc quá trình bán một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the number of items sold

examples.x: They have to boost sales to make a profit.
Retail sales fell in November by 10 per cent.
ticket/car sales
The company has seen record sales over the past year.
Online sales were up by 12 per cent.
the sales figures for May

senses.definition_vi: số lượng mặt hàng đã bán

senses.definition: the part of a company that deals with selling its products

examples.x: a sales and marketing director
She works in sales.
She works in the sales department.
He's a sales manager for a hotel group.
The Weldon Group has a 6 000 strong sales force.

senses.definition_vi: bộ phận của công ty chịu trách nhiệm bán sản phẩm của mình

senses.definition: an occasion when a shop or business sells its products at a lower price than usual

examples.x: The sale starts next week.
the January sales
I bought a coat in the sales.
a half-price sale on all bed linen
The airline is selling one third of all its seats at the sale price.

senses.definition_vi: một dịp mà một cửa hàng hoặc doanh nghiệp bán sản phẩm của mình với giá thấp hơn bình thường

senses.definition: an occasion when goods are sold, especially an auction

examples.x: a contemporary art sale
a major sale of paintings

senses.definition_vi: một dịp hàng hóa được bán, đặc biệt là đấu giá

senses.definition: available to be bought, especially from the owner

examples.x: I'm sorry, it's not for sale.
They've put their house up for sale.
an increase in the number of stolen vehicles being offered for sale
a ‘for sale’ sign
The land has come up for sale again.

senses.definition_vi: có sẵn để mua, đặc biệt là từ chủ sở hữu

senses.definition: available to be bought, especially in a shop

examples.x: Tickets are on sale from the booking office.
The new model goes on sale next month.

senses.definition_vi: có sẵn để mua, đặc biệt là trong cửa hàng

senses.definition: being offered at a reduced price

examples.x: All video equipment is on sale today and tomorrow.

senses.definition_vi: đang được bán với giá giảm

senses.definition: supplied with the agreement that any item that is not sold can be sent back without having to be paid for

examples.x: The novels are delivered to outlets on a sale or return basis.

senses.definition_vi: được cung cấp với thỏa thuận rằng bất kỳ mặt hàng nào không bán được đều có thể được gửi lại mà không phải trả tiền

senses.definition: a white substance that is added to food to make it taste better or to preserve it. Salt is obtained from mines and is also found in seawater. It is sometimes called common salt to show that it is different from other chemical salts. Its chemical name is sodium chloride.

examples.x: Pass the salt, please.
a pinch of salt (= a small amount of it)
Season with salt and pepper.
Sprinkle with salt to taste.
Avoid adding table salt to your food.
salt and vinegar crisps

senses.definition_vi: một chất màu trắng được thêm vào thực phẩm để làm cho nó ngon hơn hoặc để bảo quản nó. Muối được lấy từ mỏ và cũng có trong nước biển. Đôi khi nó được gọi là muối ăn để cho thấy nó khác với các loại muối hóa học khác. Tên hóa học của nó là natri clorua.

senses.definition: a chemical formed from a metal and an acid

examples.x: mineral salts

senses.definition_vi: một hóa chất được hình thành từ kim loại và axit

senses.definition: a substance that looks or tastes like salt

examples.x: bath salts (= used to give a pleasant smell to bath water)

senses.definition_vi: một chất trông hoặc có vị giống như muối

senses.definition: very fast and easily

examples.x: He got through the housework like a dose of salts.

senses.definition_vi: rất nhanh và dễ dàng

senses.definition: to make a difficult experience even more difficult for somebody
senses.definition_vi: làm cho một trải nghiệm khó khăn trở nên khó khăn hơn nữa đối với ai đó

senses.definition: a very good and honest person that you can always depend on
senses.definition_vi: một người rất tốt và trung thực mà bạn luôn có thể tin cậy

senses.definition: to be careful about believing that something is completely true

examples.x: If I were you, I’d take everything he says with a pinch of salt.

senses.definition_vi: cẩn thận về việc tin rằng điều gì đó là hoàn toàn đúng

senses.definition: deserving respect, especially because you do your job well

examples.x: Any teacher worth her salt knows that.

senses.definition_vi: xứng đáng được tôn trọng, đặc biệt là vì bạn làm tốt công việc của mình

senses.definition: exactly the one or ones referred to or mentioned; not different

examples.x: We have lived in the same house for twenty years.
Our children go to the same school as theirs.
She's still the same fun-loving person that I knew at college.
This one works in exactly the same way as the other.
They promise to meet again in the exact same place six months later.
They both said much the same thing.
He used the very same (= exactly the same) words.
I resigned last Friday and left that same day.
I was relieved and sad at the same time.
Gary and I look more or less the same age.
I recognized a lot of the same people.

senses.definition_vi: chính xác cái được đề cập hoặc đã đề cập; không khác

senses.definition: exactly like the one or ones referred to or mentioned

examples.x: I bought the same car as yours (= another car of that type).
She was wearing the same dress that I had on.
The same thing happened to me last week.
Most parents tend to raise their children in much the same way they were raised
Other countries don't suffer from the same kinds of health problems we do.
Older adults may not get the same level of protection from the vaccine.

senses.definition_vi: chính xác giống như cái được đề cập hoặc đã đề cập

senses.definition: used to say that a situation has not changed at all

examples.x: ‘How's it going?’ ‘Oh, same old, same old.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng một tình huống không hề thay đổi

senses.definition: used to say that a situation or the excuses, products or entertainment being offered have not improved at all

examples.x: It's the same old story  —budget cuts and government neglect.
The band's new album includes the same old stuff they've been playing forever.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng một tình huống hoặc các lời bào chữa, sản phẩm hoặc giải trí được cung cấp không hề cải thiện chút nào

senses.definition: in the same way

examples.x: We treat boys exactly the same as girls.
He gave me five dollars, same as usual.

senses.definition_vi: theo cách tương tự

senses.definition: the same thing or things

examples.x: I would do the same again.
I think the same as you do about this.
Just do the same as me (= as I do).
His latest movie is just more of the same—exotic locations, car chases and a final shoot-out.
‘I'll have coffee.’ ‘Same for me, please (= I will have one too).’

senses.definition_vi: cùng một thứ hoặc những thứ giống nhau

senses.definition: having the same number, colour, size, quality, etc.

examples.x: There are several brands and they're not all the same.
I'd like one the same as yours.

senses.definition_vi: có cùng số lượng, màu sắc, kích thước, chất lượng, v.v.

senses.definition: the same person

examples.x: ‘Was that George on the phone?’ ‘The same (= yes, it was George).’

senses.definition_vi: cùng một người

senses.definition: despite this

examples.x: He's not very reliable, but I like him just the same.
‘Will you stay for lunch?’ ‘No, but thanks all the same.’
All the same, there's some truth in what she says.

senses.definition_vi: mặc dù vậy

senses.definition: to not be important to somebody

examples.x: It's all the same to me whether we eat now or later.
I'd rather stay here, if it's all the same to you.

senses.definition_vi: không quan trọng đối với ai đó

senses.definition: the same person or thing

examples.x: It turns out that her aunt and my cousin are one and the same.
In his work, form and meaning are one and the same.

senses.definition_vi: cùng một người hoặc vật

senses.definition: used to ask somebody to serve you the same drink as before

examples.x: Same again, please!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để yêu cầu ai đó phục vụ bạn cùng một loại đồ uống như trước

senses.definition: used to say that something is also true of you

examples.x: ‘I can't wait to see it.’ ‘Same here.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng điều gì đó cũng đúng với bạn

senses.definition: used to answer a greeting, an offensive remark, etc.

examples.x: ‘Happy Christmas!’ ‘And the same to you!’
‘Get lost!’ ‘Same to you!’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để trả lời một lời chào, một lời nhận xét xúc phạm, v.v.

senses.definition: a number of people or things taken from a larger group and used in tests to provide information about the group

examples.x: The interviews were given to a random sample of students.
The survey covers a representative sample of schools.
a sample survey
The current study has a larger sample size than earlier studies.
We studied a large population sample.

senses.definition_vi: một số người hoặc vật được lấy từ một nhóm lớn hơn và được sử dụng trong các thử nghiệm để cung cấp thông tin về nhóm đó

senses.definition: a small amount of a substance taken from a larger amount and tested in order to obtain information about the substance

examples.x: a blood/urine/tissue/DNA sample
Samples of the water contained pesticide.
A small sample of blood must be tested by a doctor.
to collect/obtain/take a sample
We analyzed samples from more than a dozen common tree species.
Her sample contained traces of the banned steroid.

senses.definition_vi: một lượng nhỏ chất được lấy từ một lượng lớn hơn và được thử nghiệm để thu thập thông tin về chất đó

senses.definition: a small amount or example of something that can be looked at or tried to see what it is like

examples.x: ‘I'd like to see a sample of your work,’ said the manager.
a free sample of shampoo
Would you like a sample of the fabric to take home?
We looked at sample books to choose the fabric.

senses.definition_vi: một lượng nhỏ hoặc ví dụ về một cái gì đó có thể được xem xét hoặc thử để biết nó như thế nào

senses.definition: a piece of recorded music or sound that is used in a new piece of music

examples.x: ‘Candy’ includes a swirling sample from a Walker Brothers song.

senses.definition_vi: một đoạn nhạc hoặc âm thanh được ghi lại được sử dụng trong một đoạn nhạc mới

senses.definition: to try a small amount of a particular food to see what it is like; to experience something for a short time to see what it is like

examples.x: I sampled the delights of Greek cooking for the first time.
He put his head out of the window and sampled the morning air.
We simply had to stop and sample some road-side cuisine.

senses.definition_vi: nếm thử một lượng nhỏ một loại thực phẩm cụ thể để xem nó như thế nào; trải nghiệm một cái gì đó trong một thời gian ngắn để xem nó như thế nào

senses.definition: to test, question, etc., part of something or of a group of people in order to find out what the rest is like

examples.x: 12 per cent of the children sampled said they prefer cats to dogs.
The survey was done using a group of 100 children randomly sampled from the school population.

senses.definition_vi: thử nghiệm, đặt câu hỏi, v.v., một phần của một cái gì đó hoặc của một nhóm người để tìm hiểu phần còn lại như thế nào

senses.definition: to record part of a piece of music, or a sound, in order to use it in a new piece of music
senses.definition_vi: ghi lại một phần của một bản nhạc, hoặc một âm thanh, để sử dụng nó trong một bản nhạc mới

senses.definition: an official order that limits trade, contact, etc. with a particular country, in order to make it do something, such as obeying international law

examples.x: Trade sanctions were imposed against any country that refused to sign the agreement.
The economic sanctions have been lifted.

senses.definition_vi: một lệnh chính thức hạn chế thương mại, tiếp xúc, v.v. với một quốc gia cụ thể, để buộc quốc gia đó làm điều gì đó, chẳng hạn như tuân thủ luật pháp quốc tế

senses.definition: official permission or approval for an action or a change

examples.x: These changes will require the sanction of the court.
Their ideas received official sanction at the meeting.

senses.definition_vi: sự cho phép hoặc chấp thuận chính thức cho một hành động hoặc một sự thay đổi

senses.definition: a course of action that can be used, if necessary, to make people obey a law or behave in a particular way

examples.x: The ultimate sanction will be the closure of the restaurant.
We now have an effective sanction against the killing of whales.

senses.definition_vi: một quy trình hành động có thể được sử dụng, nếu cần, để buộc mọi người tuân theo luật hoặc hành xử theo một cách nhất định

senses.definition: a substance that consists of very small fine grains of rock. Sand is found on beaches, in deserts, etc.

examples.x: a grain of sand
coarse/fine sand
Concrete is a mixture of sand and cement.
The children were playing in the sand (= for example, in a sandpit).
The resort has its own white sand beach.
His hair was the colour of sand.
The beach is a gorgeous stretch of golden sand.

senses.definition_vi: một chất bao gồm các hạt đá rất nhỏ, mịn. Cát được tìm thấy trên bãi biển, trong sa mạc, v.v.

senses.definition: a large area of sand on a beach or in the desert

examples.x: We went for a walk along the sand.
miles of golden sands
the burning desert sands

senses.definition_vi: một khu vực cát lớn trên bãi biển hoặc trong sa mạc

senses.definition: to refuse to admit that a problem exists or refuse to deal with it
senses.definition_vi: từ chối thừa nhận rằng một vấn đề tồn tại hoặc từ chối giải quyết nó

senses.definition: (to establish) a clear limit to what you will do or accept

examples.x: It’s time to draw a line in the sand and stop allowing workplace bullying to continue.

senses.definition_vi: thiết lập một giới hạn rõ ràng cho những gì bạn sẽ làm hoặc chấp nhận

senses.definition: used to describe a situation that changes so often that it is difficult to understand or deal with it
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mô tả một tình huống thay đổi thường xuyên đến mức khó hiểu hoặc khó đối phó

senses.definition: two slices of bread, often spread with butter, with a layer of meat, cheese, etc. between them

examples.x: a ham/tuna/egg sandwich
a grilled cheese sandwich
a toasted sandwich
a sandwich bar (= a place that sells sandwiches)
I'm going to grab a sandwich (= buy one quickly) and sit in the park.
We ate turkey sandwiches and wild blueberries.

senses.definition_vi: hai lát bánh mì, thường phết bơ, với một lớp thịt, phô mai, v.v. ở giữa

senses.definition: a sponge cake consisting of two layers with jam and/or cream between them

examples.x: a chocolate sponge sandwich
a sandwich tin (= for baking such a cake in)

senses.definition_vi: một loại bánh bông lan gồm hai lớp với mứt và/hoặc kem ở giữa

senses.definition: an electronic device that is sent into space and moves around the earth or another planet. It is used for communicating by radio, television, etc. and for gathering information.

examples.x: a weather/communications/spy satellite
The interview came live by satellite from Hollywood.
They could track the tagged sea turtles by satellite.
The information was sent via a satellite link.
satellite television/TV/radio (= broadcast using a satellite)
a satellite broadcast/channel/picture
The use of satellite phones meant that journalists could report directly from the arena of the battlefront.
My car was fitted with a satellite navigation system.
The software enables the user to set up a satellite communications link.
They have successfully launched satellites into orbit.

senses.definition_vi: một thiết bị điện tử được gửi vào không gian và di chuyển quanh Trái đất hoặc một hành tinh khác. Nó được sử dụng để liên lạc bằng radio, truyền hình, v.v. và để thu thập thông tin.

senses.definition: a natural object that moves around a larger natural object in space

examples.x: The moon is a satellite of earth.

senses.definition_vi: một vật thể tự nhiên di chuyển quanh một vật thể tự nhiên lớn hơn trong không gian

senses.definition: a town, a country or an organization that is controlled by and depends on another larger or more powerful one

examples.x: Following the Second World War it became a satellite state of the Soviet Union.

senses.definition_vi: một thị trấn, một quốc gia hoặc một tổ chức được kiểm soát và phụ thuộc vào một quốc gia hoặc tổ chức khác lớn hơn hoặc mạnh hơn

senses.definition: the good feeling that you have when you have achieved something or when something that you wanted to happen does happen; something that gives you this feeling

examples.x: to gain/get/derive satisfaction from something
a look/smile of satisfaction
She looked back on her career with great satisfaction.
He had the satisfaction of seeing his book become a bestseller.
She didn't want to give him the satisfaction of seeing her cry.
The company is trying to improve customer satisfaction.
He was enjoying all the satisfactions of being a parent.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác tốt đẹp mà bạn có khi bạn đã đạt được điều gì đó hoặc khi điều gì đó bạn muốn xảy ra đã xảy ra; điều gì đó mang lại cho bạn cảm giác này

senses.definition: the act of fulfilling a need or desire

examples.x: the satisfaction of sexual desires
the satisfaction of your ambitions

senses.definition_vi: hành động đáp ứng một nhu cầu hoặc mong muốn

senses.definition: an acceptable way of dealing with a complaint, a debt, an injury, etc.

examples.x: I complained to the manager but I didn't get any satisfaction.
They agreed on a payment of £200 in full satisfaction of the debt.

senses.definition_vi: một cách chấp nhận được để giải quyết một khiếu nại, một khoản nợ, một vết thương, v.v.

senses.definition: if you do something to somebody’s satisfaction, they are pleased with it

examples.x: The affair was settled to the complete satisfaction of the client.
The matter was resolved to our general satisfaction.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn làm điều gì đó làm hài lòng ai đó, họ sẽ hài lòng về điều đó

senses.definition: if you prove something to somebody’s satisfaction, they believe or accept it

examples.x: Can you demonstrate to our satisfaction that your story is true?

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn chứng minh điều gì đó làm hài lòng ai đó, họ sẽ tin hoặc chấp nhận điều đó

senses.definition: pleased because you have achieved something or because something that you wanted to happen has happened

examples.x: a satisfied customer
a satisfied smile
She's never satisfied with what she's got.
The Olympic athlete was satisfied with her performance.
They were not satisfied with the outcome of the talks.

senses.definition_vi: hài lòng vì bạn đã đạt được điều gì đó hoặc vì điều gì đó bạn muốn xảy ra đã xảy ra

senses.definition: believing or accepting that something is true

examples.x: I'm satisfied that they are telling the truth.
Police were satisfied that the death was accidental.
I am quite satisfied he will return to France.
She seemed satisfied with my explanation.
The police are not satisfied with the answers they have received.
We are still not entirely satisfied with the explanation offered.
You need to be satisfied of all the facts.

senses.definition_vi: tin hoặc chấp nhận rằng điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: to make somebody pleased by doing or giving them what they want

examples.x: Nothing satisfies him—he's always complaining.
The proposed plan will not satisfy everyone.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó hài lòng bằng cách làm hoặc cho họ những gì họ muốn

senses.definition: to provide what is wanted, needed or asked for

examples.x: The food wasn't enough to satisfy his hunger.
to satisfy somebody’s curiosity
The education system must satisfy the needs of all children.
We cannot satisfy demand for the product.
to satisfy a requirement/condition/criterion
She failed to satisfy all the requirements for entry to the college.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp những gì được mong muốn, cần thiết hoặc yêu cầu

senses.definition: to make somebody certain something is true or has been done

examples.x: Her explanation did not satisfy the teacher.
People need to be satisfied of the need for a new system.
Once I had satisfied myself (that) it was the right decision, we went ahead.
All you have to do is satisfy the court he is not at risk.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó chắc chắn rằng điều gì đó là đúng hoặc đã được thực hiện

senses.definition: the day of the week after Friday and before Sunday

examples.x: It's Saturday today, isn't it?
She started art classes last Saturday.
Are you busy next Saturday?
Saturday morning/afternoon/evening
We'll chat at Saturday's party.
I work Saturday to Wednesday.
I work Saturdays to Wednesdays.
We'll meet on Saturday (= next Saturday).
We met on Saturday (= last Saturday).
We'll meet Saturday.
The office is closed on Saturdays (= every Saturday).
The office is closed Saturdays.
He was born on a Saturday.
I always do yoga on a Saturday (= every Saturday).
I went to Mexico City on Monday, and came back the following Saturday.
‘When did the accident happen?’ ‘It was the Saturday (= the Saturday of the week we are talking about).’
Come back Saturday week (= a week after next Saturday).

senses.definition_vi: ngày trong tuần sau ngày thứ Sáu và trước ngày Chủ Nhật

senses.definition: a thick liquid that is eaten with food to add taste to it

examples.x: tomato/cranberry/chilli sauce
chicken in a white sauce
ice cream with a hot fudge sauce
pasta sauce (= sauce that is served with pasta)
A honey-mustard dipping sauce helped add flavour to the crab cakes.
coconut tart served with hot chocolate sauce

senses.definition_vi: một chất lỏng đặc được ăn kèm với thức ăn để tăng hương vị

senses.definition: talk or behaviour that is annoying or shows no respect
senses.definition_vi: lời nói hoặc hành vi gây khó chịu hoặc thiếu tôn trọng

senses.definition: what one person is allowed to do, another person must be allowed to do in a similar situation
senses.definition_vi: những gì một người được phép làm, người khác cũng phải được phép làm trong một tình huống tương tự

senses.definition: to keep somebody/something safe from death, harm, loss, etc.

examples.x: to save somebody’s life
Doctors were unable to save her.
He's trying to save their marriage.
She needs to win the next two games to save the match.
Workers chose longer hours in order to save jobs.
If you really want to save the planet, sell your car.
Thanks for doing that. You saved my life (= helped me a lot).
She started a campaign to save her business.
to save a rare species from extinction
His intrepid act saved five men from death.
Money from local businesses helped save the school from closure.
This new technology might just have the power to save the world from ecological disaster.
She saved a little girl from falling into the water.

senses.definition_vi: giữ cho ai đó/điều gì đó an toàn khỏi chết, tổn hại, mất mát, v.v.

senses.definition: to keep money instead of spending it, especially in order to buy a particular thing

examples.x: I'm not very good at saving.
We scrimp and save to send our children to a private school.
I'm saving up to buy a new car.
I'm saving for a new bike.
For all younger people in the US saving for retirement will be an absolute necessity.
We've been saving up to go to Australia.
I'm trying to save up for my holiday.
You should save a little each week.
I've saved almost £100 so far.
He saved up some money and made plans to travel.
He's been saving his allowance up for a new bike.

senses.definition_vi: giữ tiền thay vì chi tiêu, đặc biệt là để mua một món đồ cụ thể

senses.definition: to avoid wasting something or using more than necessary

examples.x: People are looking for ways to save money.
We'll take a cab to save time.
Recycling waste saves energy.
Images are captured in black and white to save hard disk space.
Book early and save £50!
We should try to save water.
The government is trying to save £1 million on defence.
If we go this way it will save us two hours on the trip.
A professional wedding coordinator can save you time and money.
I save on fares by walking to work.

senses.definition_vi: tránh lãng phí hoặc sử dụng nhiều hơn mức cần thiết

senses.definition: to keep something to use or enjoy in the future or for somebody else to use

examples.x: He's saving his strength for the last part of the race.
We'll eat some now and save some for tomorrow.
Save some food for me.
The main event is saved until last.
Save me some food.
I won't save you a seat if you're late.

senses.definition_vi: giữ lại một cái gì đó để sử dụng hoặc tận hưởng trong tương lai hoặc để người khác sử dụng

senses.definition: to make a computer keep data by putting a copy in a location where it will be stored

examples.x: We recommend you save regularly by clicking on the update button.
Save data frequently.
All your recent searches are automatically saved.
The data can be saved to disk.

senses.definition_vi: lưu giữ dữ liệu máy tính bằng cách đặt một bản sao vào một vị trí sẽ được lưu trữ

senses.definition: to collect something because you like it or for a special purpose

examples.x: I've been saving theatre programmes for years.
If you save ten tokens you can get a T-shirt.

senses.definition_vi: thu thập một cái gì đó vì bạn thích nó hoặc cho một mục đích đặc biệt

senses.definition: to avoid doing something difficult or unpleasant; to make somebody able to avoid doing something difficult or unpleasant

examples.x: The prize money saved her from having to find a job.
She did it herself to save argument.
Thanks for sending that letter for me—it saved me a trip.
The new system will save people the trouble of taking recyclable materials to collection points.
He's grown a beard to save shaving.
If you phone for an appointment, it'll save you waiting.

senses.definition_vi: tránh làm điều gì đó khó khăn hoặc khó chịu; giúp ai đó tránh làm điều gì đó khó khăn hoặc khó chịu

senses.definition: to prevent an opponent’s shot from going in the goal

examples.x: to save a penalty
The goalie saved Johnson's long-range shot.
The goalie saved brilliantly from Johnson's long-range shot.

senses.definition_vi: ngăn một cú sút của đối phương đi vào lưới

senses.definition: to prevent a person's soul from going to hell

examples.x: The missionaries believed they were sent to save souls.
A large poster proclaimed, ‘Jesus saves.’

senses.definition_vi: cứu linh hồn một người khỏi địa ngục

senses.definition: to be completely unable to do something

examples.x: He can't interview people to save his life.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn không thể làm gì

senses.definition: to rescue somebody from a very difficult situation

examples.x: He's out to save his own political neck.

senses.definition_vi: giải cứu ai đó khỏi một tình huống rất khó khăn

senses.definition: used to tell somebody that it is not worth wasting time and effort saying something because it will not change anything

examples.x: Save your breath—you'll never persuade her.
It's useless talking to him—you may as well save your breath.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói với ai đó rằng không đáng lãng phí thời gian và công sức để nói điều gì đó vì nó sẽ không thay đổi bất cứ điều gì

senses.definition: to prevent failure or defeat, when this seems certain to happen

examples.x: Salah's late goal saved the day for Liverpool.

senses.definition_vi: ngăn chặn sự thất bại hoặc thua cuộc, khi điều này dường như chắc chắn xảy ra

senses.definition: to avoid or help somebody avoid being embarrassed

examples.x: She was fired, but she saved face by telling everyone she'd resigned.

senses.definition_vi: tránh hoặc giúp ai đó tránh bị bẽ mặt

senses.definition: to try to avoid death, punishment, etc., especially by leaving others in an extremely difficult situation

examples.x: To save his own skin, he lied and blamed the accident on his friend.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng tránh chết, bị trừng phạt, v.v., đặc biệt là bằng cách bỏ rơi người khác trong một tình huống cực kỳ khó khăn

senses.definition: an amount of something such as time or money that you do not need to use or spend

examples.x: Buy three and make a saving of 55p.
With the new boiler you can make big savings on fuel bills.
The company reported cost savings of about $ 29 million during the second quarter.
The new building enjoys energy savings of 25 percent annually.
The service has delivered significant cost savings.

senses.definition_vi: một lượng thời gian hoặc tiền bạc mà bạn không cần sử dụng hoặc chi tiêu

senses.definition: money that you have saved, especially in a bank, etc.

examples.x: He put all his savings into buying a boat.
She spent her entire life savings (= all the money she had saved throughout her life) to furnish and equip the house.
Tan financed the film himself from his personal savings.
He's living off his retirement savings.
Savings rates are at historic lows.

senses.definition_vi: tiền bạn đã tiết kiệm, đặc biệt là trong ngân hàng, v.v.

senses.definition: that prevents the waste of the thing mentioned or stops it from being necessary

examples.x: labour-saving devices
space-saving fitted furniture

senses.definition_vi: ngăn chặn sự lãng phí của thứ được đề cập hoặc ngăn nó trở nên cần thiết

senses.definition: the right to influence something by giving your opinion before a decision is made

examples.x: We had no say in the decision to sell the company.
People want a greater say in local government.
The judge has the final say on the sentence.

senses.definition_vi: quyền ảnh hưởng đến một điều gì đó bằng cách đưa ra ý kiến của bạn trước khi một quyết định được đưa ra

senses.definition: to have the opportunity to express yourself fully about something

examples.x: She won't be happy until she's had her say.

senses.definition_vi: có cơ hội để bạn bày tỏ bản thân một cách đầy đủ về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to speak or tell somebody something, using words

examples.x: ‘Hello!’ she said.
‘That was marvellous,’ said Daniel.
A legendary football coach once said, ‘Winning is everything.’
Be quiet, I have something to say.
Come and say hello.
Please say yes!
I didn't believe a word she said.
That's a terrible thing to say.
She said nothing to me about it.
I said to myself (= thought), ‘That can't be right!’
He said (that) his name was Sam.
Can I just say I'm not happy about this?
I have to say I was pleasantly surprised.
It is said that she lived to be over 100.
She finds it hard to say what she feels.
‘That's impossible!’ ‘So you say (= but I think you may be wrong).’
‘Why can't I go out now?’ ‘Because I say so.’
‘What do you want it for?’ ‘I'd rather not say.’
He said to meet him here.
He is said to have been a brilliant scholar.

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc kể cho ai đó điều gì đó, bằng lời nói

senses.definition: to repeat words, phrases, etc.

examples.x: to say a prayer
Try to say that line with more conviction.

senses.definition_vi: lặp lại các từ, cụm từ, v.v.

senses.definition: to give particular information or instructions

examples.x: The notice said ‘Keep Out’.
The clock said three o'clock.
The instructions say (that) we should leave it to set for four hours.
The book doesn't say where he was born.
The guidebook says to turn left.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp thông tin hoặc chỉ dẫn cụ thể

senses.definition: to express an opinion on something

examples.x: Say what you like (= although you disagree) about her, she's a fine singer.
I'll say this for them, they're a very efficient company.
Anna thinks I'm lazy—what do you say (= what is your opinion)?
I can't say I blame her for resigning (= I think she was right).
I have to say I enjoyed every minute.
I say (= suggest) we go without them.
I wouldn't say they were rich (= in my opinion they are not rich).
That's not to say it's a bad movie (= it is good but it is not without faults).
It's hard to say what caused the accident.
It's difficult to say whether the story is true.
‘When will it be finished?’ ‘I couldn't say (= I don't know).’
Is it worth it? I would say not.

senses.definition_vi: bày tỏ ý kiến về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to make thoughts, feelings, etc. clear to somebody by using words, looks, movements, etc.

examples.x: His angry glance said it all.
Just what is the artist trying to say in her work?
The museum's architects have managed to say something about our national story.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho suy nghĩ, cảm xúc, v.v. trở nên rõ ràng với ai đó bằng cách sử dụng lời nói, ánh mắt, cử chỉ, v.v.

senses.definition: to show, sometimes indirectly, what somebody/something is like

examples.x: That says it all really, doesn't it? (= it shows clearly what is true)
The incident says an awful lot about his character.
This says to me that there is more here than you are letting on.

senses.definition_vi: cho thấy, đôi khi là gián tiếp, ai đó/điều gì đó như thế nào

senses.definition: to suggest or give something as an example or a possibility

examples.x: You could learn the basics in, let's say, three months.
Let’s take any writer, say (= for example) Dickens…
Say you lose your job: what would you do then?
Just say he refuses to talk to you.

senses.definition_vi: đề xuất hoặc đưa ra điều gì đó làm ví dụ hoặc khả năng

senses.definition: to be much more difficult to do than to talk about

examples.x: ‘Why don't you get yourself a job?’ ‘That's easier said than done.’

senses.definition_vi: khó thực hiện hơn nhiều so với nói về nó

senses.definition: very quickly; in a very short time
senses.definition_vi: rất nhanh; trong một thời gian rất ngắn

senses.definition: used to say that you understand a situation and there is no need to say any more

examples.x: ‘He's a politician, remember.’ ‘Enough said.’

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn hiểu tình hình và không cần nói thêm gì nữa

senses.definition: to be very obvious or easy to predict

examples.x: Of course I'll help you. That goes without saying.

senses.definition_vi: rất rõ ràng hoặc dễ đoán

senses.definition: to be ready, unwilling, etc. to talk or give your views on something

examples.x: She doesn't have much to say for herself (= doesn't take part in conversation).
He had plenty to say for himself (= he had a lot of opinions and was willing to talk).
Late again—what have you got to say for yourself (= what is your excuse)?

senses.definition_vi: sẵn sàng, không muốn, v.v. nói chuyện hoặc đưa ra quan điểm của bạn về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to be angry

examples.x: He knew that if he wasn't back by midnight, his parents would have something to say about it.

senses.definition_vi: tức giận

senses.definition: used to introduce an opinion that makes what you have just said seem less strong

examples.x: I sometimes get worried in this job. Having said that, I enjoy doing it, it's a challenge.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để đưa ra một ý kiến làm cho điều bạn vừa nói có vẻ bớt mạnh mẽ hơn

senses.definition: used when you are saying that something is likely

examples.x: I dare say you know about it already.

senses.definition_vi: dùng khi bạn nói rằng điều gì đó có khả năng xảy ra

senses.definition: used when you are going to criticize somebody or say something that might upset them

examples.x: That colour doesn't really suit you, if you don't mind my saying so.

senses.definition_vi: dùng khi bạn sắp chỉ trích ai đó hoặc nói điều gì đó có thể làm họ buồn

senses.definition: used to tell somebody that you have listened to their opinion, especially when you are going to express a different opinion

examples.x: I hear what you're saying, but you're wrong.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói với ai đó rằng bạn đã lắng nghe ý kiến của họ, đặc biệt là khi bạn sắp đưa ra một ý kiến khác

senses.definition: used for emphasis to say ‘yes’

examples.x: ‘Does she see him often?’ ‘I'll say! Nearly every day.’

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh khi nói 'có'

senses.definition: used when you are commenting on a situation and saying that you are happy about it

examples.x: Most teachers, I'm glad to say, take their jobs very seriously.

senses.definition_vi: dùng khi bạn đang nhận xét về một tình huống và nói rằng bạn hài lòng về nó

senses.definition: used for saying that something is disappointing

examples.x: He didn't accept the job, I'm sorry to say.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó gây thất vọng

senses.definition: used to emphasize an opinion

examples.x: Well, I must say, that's the funniest thing I've heard all week.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh một ý kiến

senses.definition: used to express surprise, shock, etc.

examples.x: I say! What a huge cake!

senses.definition_vi: dùng để bày tỏ sự ngạc nhiên, sốc, v.v.

senses.definition: used to attract somebody’s attention or introduce a new subject of conversation

examples.x: I say, can you lend me five pounds?

senses.definition_vi: dùng để thu hút sự chú ý của ai đó hoặc bắt đầu một chủ đề trò chuyện mới

senses.definition: it shows a good/bad quality that somebody/something has

examples.x: It says a lot for her that she never lost her temper.
It didn't say much for their efficiency that the order arrived a week late.

senses.definition_vi: cho thấy một phẩm chất tốt/xấu mà ai đó/điều gì đó có

senses.definition: used to say that you would like something or to accept something that is offered

examples.x: I wouldn't say no to a pizza.
‘Tea, Brian?’ ‘I wouldn't say no.’

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn muốn điều gì đó hoặc chấp nhận điều gì đó được đề nghị

senses.definition: a bad situation will pass or be forgotten most quickly if nothing more is said about it
senses.definition_vi: một tình huống tồi tệ sẽ qua đi hoặc bị lãng quên nhanh nhất nếu không ai nói thêm gì về nó

senses.definition: the best thing to do is say as little as possible about something
senses.definition_vi: việc tốt nhất nên làm là nói càng ít càng tốt về điều gì đó

senses.definition: used when commenting on a situation to suggest that you could say something more or worse but prefer not to

examples.x: Let's just say he wasn't very happy about the decision (= he was very unhappy or angry about it).

senses.definition_vi: dùng khi nhận xét về một tình huống để gợi ý rằng bạn có thể nói nhiều hơn hoặc tệ hơn nhưng thà không nói

senses.definition: used when making a suggestion or giving an example

examples.x: I can let you have it for, well let's say £100.

senses.definition_vi: dùng khi đưa ra một gợi ý hoặc một ví dụ

senses.definition: used to emphasize what you are saying or to ask somebody if they really mean what they say

examples.x: I mean to say, you should have known how he would react!
Do you mean to say you've lost it?

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh điều bạn đang nói hoặc hỏi ai đó xem họ có thực sự có ý đó không

senses.definition: used to emphasize that the information you are giving is obvious

examples.x: The problem, needless to say, is the cost involved.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng thông tin bạn đang đưa ra là hiển nhiên

senses.definition: do not stop hoping
senses.definition_vi: đừng ngừng hy vọng

senses.definition: used to say that something was, or will be, done immediately
senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó đã, hoặc sẽ được, thực hiện ngay lập tức

senses.definition: to never say anything good about somebody/something

examples.x: Nobody had a good word to say about him.

senses.definition_vi: không bao giờ nói điều gì tốt đẹp về ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to be very shy or gentle

examples.x: He's so nervous he wouldn't say boo to a goose.

senses.definition_vi: rất nhút nhát hoặc dịu dàng

senses.definition: used to introduce a stronger way of describing something

examples.x: a difficult, not to say impossible, task

senses.short_meaning_vi: giới thiệu cách nói mạnh hơn
senses.definition_vi: dùng để giới thiệu một cách mạnh mẽ hơn để mô tả điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to ask somebody to smile before you take their photograph
senses.definition_vi: dùng để yêu cầu ai đó mỉm cười trước khi bạn chụp ảnh họ

senses.definition: to say something important

examples.x: You said a mouthful there, buddy.

senses.definition_vi: nói điều gì đó quan trọng

senses.definition: to refuse an offer, a suggestion, etc.

examples.x: If you don't invest in this, you're saying no to a potential fortune.

senses.definition_vi: từ chối một lời đề nghị, một gợi ý, v.v.

senses.definition: used to say that you understand exactly what somebody means or is trying to say, so it is unnecessary to say anything more

examples.x: ‘They went to Paris together.’ ‘Say no more!’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng bạn hiểu chính xác ý của ai đó hoặc điều họ đang cố gắng nói, vì vậy không cần nói thêm gì nữa

senses.definition: to say exactly what you feel or think
senses.definition_vi: nói chính xác những gì bạn cảm thấy hoặc nghĩ

senses.definition: used to express surprise at what somebody has just said

examples.x: ‘He's getting married.’ ‘Say what?’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để bày tỏ sự ngạc nhiên về những gì ai đó vừa nói

senses.definition: used to ask somebody to tell you when you should stop pouring a drink or serving food for them because they have enough
senses.definition_vi: được dùng để hỏi ai đó khi nào bạn nên ngừng rót đồ uống hoặc phục vụ thức ăn cho họ vì họ đã đủ rồi

senses.definition: to give an order; to make a request

examples.x: Just say the word, and I'll go.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra một mệnh lệnh; đưa ra một yêu cầu

senses.definition: used to suggest that although you could say more, what you do say will be enough to explain what you mean

examples.x: I won’t go into all the details. Suffice it to say that the whole event was a complete disaster.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để gợi ý rằng mặc dù bạn có thể nói nhiều hơn, nhưng những gì bạn nói sẽ đủ để giải thích ý bạn muốn nói

senses.definition: in other words

examples.x: three days from now, that is to say on Friday

senses.definition_vi: nói cách khác

senses.definition: used to introduce an opinion that makes what you have just said seem less strong
senses.definition_vi: được dùng để giới thiệu một ý kiến làm cho những gì bạn vừa nói có vẻ bớt mạnh mẽ hơn

senses.definition: used to say that something is not very unusual or special

examples.x: She's a better player than me, but that's not saying much (= because I am a very bad player).

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng một điều gì đó không quá khác thường hoặc đặc biệt

senses.definition: used to say that it is impossible to predict what might happen

examples.x: There's no saying how he'll react.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng không thể đoán trước điều gì có thể xảy ra

senses.definition: there are/are not good reasons for doing something, believing something or agreeing with something
senses.definition_vi: có những lý do tốt để làm điều gì đó, tin vào điều gì đó hoặc đồng ý với điều gì đó

senses.definition: without making something seem better, worse, more serious, etc. than it really is

examples.x: I was surprised, to say the least.

senses.definition_vi: không làm cho điều gì đó có vẻ tốt hơn, tệ hơn, nghiêm trọng hơn, v.v. so với thực tế của nó

senses.definition: used to introduce a further fact or thing in addition to those already mentioned

examples.x: It was too expensive, to say nothing of the time it wasted.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để giới thiệu một sự thật hoặc một điều gì đó khác ngoài những điều đã được đề cập trước đó

senses.definition: I agree completely

examples.x: ‘We must stand up for ourselves.’ ‘Well said, John.’

senses.definition_vi: tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý

senses.definition: would you like something/to do something?

examples.x: What would you say to eating out tonight?
Let's go away for a weekend. What do you say?

senses.definition_vi: bạn có muốn thứ gì đó/làm gì đó không?

senses.definition: used to agree to somebody’s suggestion because you do not want to argue
senses.definition_vi: đồng ý với đề xuất của ai đó vì bạn không muốn tranh cãi

senses.definition: a particular person must be obeyed

examples.x: Sarah wanted the kitchen painted green, and what she says, goes.

senses.definition_vi: một người cụ thể phải được tuân theo

senses.definition: when everything is considered

examples.x: I know you're upset, but when all's said and done it isn't exactly a disaster.

senses.definition_vi: khi mọi thứ được xem xét

senses.definition: used to say that nobody knows the answer to a question

examples.x: Who can say what will happen next year?

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng không ai biết câu trả lời cho một câu hỏi

senses.definition: used to disagree with a statement or an opinion

examples.x: Who says I can't do it?

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để không đồng ý với một tuyên bố hoặc một ý kiến

senses.definition: used to say that something might happen or might have happened in a particular way, because nobody really knows

examples.x: Who's to say we would not have succeeded if we'd had more time?

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng một điều gì đó có thể xảy ra hoặc có thể đã xảy ra theo một cách nhất định, vì không ai thực sự biết

senses.definition: I agree with you completely

examples.x: ‘He's in a bad mood today.’ ‘You can say that again!’

senses.definition_vi: tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý với bạn

senses.definition: used to say that you think the offer you are making is reasonable or generous

examples.x: Look, I'll give you £100 for it. You can't say fairer than that.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng bạn nghĩ lời đề nghị bạn đưa ra là hợp lý hoặc hào phóng

senses.definition: used to express surprise

examples.x: ‘They left without us.’ ‘You don't say!’ (= I'm not surprised)

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để bày tỏ sự ngạc nhiên

senses.definition: used to agree with somebody when they say something about themselves that you would not have been rude enough to say yourself

examples.x: ‘I know I'm not the world's greatest cook.’ ‘You said it!’

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để đồng ý với ai đó khi họ nói điều gì đó về bản thân mà bạn không đủ lịch sự để nói ra

senses.definition: used to agree with somebody’s suggestion
senses.definition_vi: được dùng để đồng ý với đề xuất của ai đó

senses.definition: the size or extent of something, especially when compared with something else

examples.x: They entertain on a large scale (= they hold expensive parties with a lot of guests).
Here was corruption on a grand scale.
On a global scale, 77 per cent of energy is created from fossil fuels.
Corporations are borrowing on a massive scale.
Western-style consumerism is unsustainable on a global scale.
Manufacturing is done on a small scale.
His work as a portrait painter is small in scale.
to achieve economies of scale in production (= to produce many items so the cost of producing each one is reduced)
It was impossible to comprehend the full scale of the disaster.
It was not until morning that the sheer scale of the damage could be seen (= how great it was).
The scale of the problem is difficult to measure.

senses.definition_vi: kích thước hoặc phạm vi của một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là khi so sánh với một cái gì đó khác

senses.definition: a range of levels or numbers used for measuring something

examples.x: a five-point pay scale
to evaluate performance on a scale from 1 to 10
The salary scale goes from £12 000 to £20 000.
a scale of charges
Use the following scale to rate each item.

senses.definition_vi: một phạm vi các cấp độ hoặc số được sử dụng để đo lường một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the set of all the different levels of something, from the lowest to the highest

examples.x: At the other end of the scale, life is a constant struggle to get enough to eat.
You're higher on the social scale than I am.

senses.definition_vi: tập hợp tất cả các cấp độ khác nhau của một cái gì đó, từ thấp nhất đến cao nhất

senses.definition: a series of marks at regular points on an instrument that is used for measuring

examples.x: How much does it read on the scale?
He read the altitude in degrees off the scale.

senses.definition_vi: một loạt các dấu ở các điểm đều nhau trên một dụng cụ dùng để đo lường

senses.definition: an instrument for weighing people or things

examples.x: bathroom/kitchen/weighing scales
the scales of justice (= represented as the two pans on a balance)

senses.definition_vi: một dụng cụ để cân người hoặc vật

senses.definition: the relation between the actual size of something and its size on a map, diagram or model that represents it

examples.x: a scale of 1:25 000
a scale model/drawing
Both plans are drawn to the same scale.
Is this diagram to scale? (= are all its parts the same size and shape in relation to each other as they are in the thing represented)

senses.definition_vi: mối quan hệ giữa kích thước thực tế của một vật và kích thước của nó trên bản đồ, sơ đồ hoặc mô hình đại diện cho nó

senses.definition: a series of musical notes moving upwards or downwards, with fixed intervals between each note, especially a series of eight starting on a particular note

examples.x: the scale of C major
to practise scales on the piano

senses.definition_vi: một chuỗi các nốt nhạc đi lên hoặc đi xuống, với các khoảng cách cố định giữa mỗi nốt, đặc biệt là một chuỗi tám nốt bắt đầu bằng một nốt cụ thể

senses.definition: any of the thin plates of hard material that cover the skin of many fish and reptiles

examples.x: The beast was a dragon, with great purple and green scales.

senses.definition_vi: bất kỳ tấm cứng có hình dạng như tấm mỏng nào bằng vật liệu cứng bao phủ da của nhiều loài cá và bò sát

senses.definition: a hard white substance that is sometimes left inside water pipes and containers for heating water
senses.definition_vi: một chất rắn màu trắng đôi khi còn lại bên trong các đường ống nước và các vật chứa để đun nóng nước

senses.definition: a hard substance that forms on teeth, especially when they are not cleaned regularly
senses.definition_vi: một chất rắn hình thành trên răng, đặc biệt là khi chúng không được làm sạch thường xuyên

senses.definition: to affect the result of something in one way rather than another

examples.x: In an interview, smart presentation can tip the scales in your favour.
New evidence tipped the balance against the prosecution.

senses.definition_vi: ảnh hưởng đến kết quả của một điều gì đó theo một cách nào đó thay vì cách khác

senses.definition: to weigh a particular amount

examples.x: He tipped the scales at just over 80 kilos.

senses.definition_vi: cân một lượng nhất định

senses.definition: to look quickly but not very carefully at a document, etc.

examples.x: I scanned the list quickly for my name.
We quickly scanned the menu.
She scanned through the newspaper over breakfast.
You should teach students to scan for essential information.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn nhanh nhưng không cẩn thận vào một tài liệu, v.v.

senses.definition: to look at every part of something carefully, especially because you are looking for a particular thing or person

examples.x: He scanned the horizon for any sign of land.
She scanned the room for an empty seat.
She scanned his face anxiously.
She scanned the street nervously, looking for the two men.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn kỹ mọi bộ phận của một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là vì bạn đang tìm kiếm một thứ hoặc một người cụ thể

senses.definition: to pass light over a picture or document using a scanner in order to copy it and put it in the memory of a computer

examples.x: How do I scan a photo and attach it to an email?
digitally scanned photographs
This recognizes text in a scanned image.
The pencil image is scanned into a computer.

senses.definition_vi: quét ánh sáng qua một bức tranh hoặc tài liệu bằng máy quét để sao chép và đưa vào bộ nhớ máy tính

senses.definition: to get an image of an object, a part of somebody’s body, etc. on a computer by passing X-rays, ultrasound waves or electromagnetic waves over it in a special machine

examples.x: Their brains are scanned so that researchers can monitor the progress of the disease.

senses.definition_vi: lấy hình ảnh của một vật thể, một bộ phận cơ thể người, v.v. trên máy tính bằng cách cho tia X, sóng siêu âm hoặc sóng điện từ đi qua nó trong một máy đặc biệt

senses.definition: to pass across an area

examples.x: Concealed video cameras scan every part of the compound.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển qua một khu vực

senses.definition: to examine a computer program or document in order to look for a virus

examples.x: This software is designed to scan all new files for viruses.

senses.definition_vi: kiểm tra một chương trình máy tính hoặc tài liệu để tìm virus

senses.definition: to have a regular rhythm according to fixed rules

examples.x: This line doesn't scan.

senses.definition_vi: có một nhịp điệu đều đặn theo các quy tắc cố định

senses.definition: behaviour or an event that people think is morally or legally wrong and causes public feelings of shock or anger

examples.x: a series of sex scandals
to cause/create a scandal
The scandal broke (= became known to the public) in May.
There has been no hint of scandal during his time in office.
a promising career wrecked by scandal

senses.definition_vi: hành vi hoặc sự kiện mà mọi người cho là sai trái về mặt đạo đức hoặc pháp lý và gây ra cảm giác sốc hoặc tức giận của công chúng

senses.definition: talk or reports about the very bad or wrong things that people have done or are thought to have done

examples.x: to spread scandal
newspapers full of scandal

senses.definition_vi: những lời nói hoặc báo cáo về những điều rất tệ hoặc sai trái mà mọi người đã làm hoặc được cho là đã làm

senses.definition: an action, attitude, etc. that you think is very wrong and not at all acceptable

examples.x: It is a scandal that such a large city has no orchestra.
The real scandal is that nothing has been done to make sure it doesn't happen again.

senses.definition_vi: một hành động, thái độ, v.v. mà bạn cho là rất sai trái và hoàn toàn không thể chấp nhận được

senses.definition: a situation in which a lot of people are anxious or frightened about something

examples.x: a health scare
recent scares about pesticides in food
a scare story (= a news report that spreads more anxiety or fear about something than is necessary)
to cause a major scare
scare tactics (= ways of persuading people to do something by frightening them)

senses.definition_vi: một tình huống mà nhiều người lo lắng hoặc sợ hãi về điều gì đó

senses.definition: a sudden feeling of fear

examples.x: You gave me a scare!
We've had quite a scare.

senses.definition_vi: một cảm giác sợ hãi đột ngột

senses.definition: to frighten somebody

examples.x: You scared me.

examples.cf: it scares somebody to do something
examples.x: It scared me to think I was alone in the building.

senses.definition_vi: làm ai đó sợ hãi

senses.definition: to become frightened

examples.x: He doesn't scare easily.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên sợ hãi

senses.definition: to frighten somebody very much
senses.definition_vi: làm ai đó sợ chết khiếp

senses.definition: to frighten somebody very much

examples.x: You scared the life out of me coming in so suddenly like that.

senses.definition_vi: làm ai đó sợ chết khiếp

senses.definition: to frighten somebody very much

examples.x: Spiders frighten him to death.

senses.definition_vi: làm ai đó sợ chết khiếp

senses.definition: to frighten somebody very much
senses.definition_vi: làm ai đó sợ chết khiếp

senses.definition: frightened of something or afraid that something bad might happen

examples.x: The thieves got scared and ran away.
He looked scared and hid behind Jesse.
She is scared of going out alone.
He's scared of heights.
People are scared to use the buses late at night.
Some victims are too scared to speak out.
I’m scared (that) I’m going to fall.
He was scared at the prospect of running out of food.
Anne was scared at seeing her father crying.
We were scared for our lives (= thought we would die).
a scared look
I was scared to death (= very frightened).
We were scared stiff (= very frightened).
He's scared out of his mind (= very frightened).

senses.definition_vi: sợ hãi điều gì đó hoặc lo sợ điều gì đó tồi tệ có thể xảy ra

senses.definition: to be very easily frightened; to be very nervous
senses.definition_vi: rất dễ bị sợ hãi; rất lo lắng

senses.definition: to be very frightened; to frighten somebody very much

examples.x: I was scared out of my wits!
The latest news has scared the wits out of investors.

senses.definition_vi: rất sợ hãi; làm ai đó sợ hãi rất nhiều

senses.definition: to be extremely frightened or bored
senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ sợ hãi hoặc chán nản

senses.definition: frightening

examples.x: It was a really scary moment.
a scary movie
Close up the statue looked even more scary.
It was a pretty scary experience.

senses.definition_vi: gây sợ hãi

senses.definition: spread far apart over a wide area or over a long period of time

examples.x: a few scattered settlements
sunshine with scattered showers
Her family are scattered around the world.

senses.definition_vi: trải rộng ra xa trên một khu vực rộng lớn hoặc trong một khoảng thời gian dài

senses.definition: a description of how things might happen in the future

examples.x: Let me suggest a possible scenario.
The worst-case scenario (= the worst possible thing that could happen) would be for the factory to be closed down.
a nightmare scenario

senses.definition_vi: mô tả về cách mọi thứ có thể xảy ra trong tương lai

senses.definition: a written outline of what happens in a film or play
senses.definition_vi: bản phác thảo bằng văn bản về những gì xảy ra trong một bộ phim hoặc vở kịch

senses.definition: the place where something happens, especially something unpleasant

examples.x: the scene of the accident/crime/crash
The attacker fled the scene.
Italy was the scene of many demonstrations at that time.
Firefighters arrived on the scene within minutes.
Sadly the man died at the scene.

senses.definition_vi: nơi xảy ra một sự việc, đặc biệt là một sự việc không dễ chịu

senses.definition: an event or a situation that you see, especially one of a particular type

examples.x: The team's victory produced scenes of jubilation all over the country.
a scene of devastation/carnage
She witnessed some very distressing scenes.

senses.definition_vi: một sự kiện hoặc tình huống mà bạn nhìn thấy, đặc biệt là một loại nhất định

senses.definition: a part of a film, play or book in which the action happens in one place or is of one particular type

examples.x: sex/fight/action/battle scenes
deleted scenes (= ones that were not included in the final version)
to film/shoot a scene
They shot the opening scene 15 times.
I got very nervous before my big scene (= the one where I have a very important part).
The scene where he arrives at the factory is the turning point in the book.

senses.definition_vi: một phần của phim, vở kịch hoặc sách nơi hành động diễn ra ở một địa điểm hoặc thuộc một loại nhất định

senses.definition: one of the small sections that a play or an opera is divided into

examples.x: Act I, Scene 2 of ‘Macbeth’

senses.definition_vi: một trong những phần nhỏ mà một vở kịch hoặc một vở opera được chia thành

senses.definition: a particular area of activity or way of life and the people who are part of it

examples.x: the art/club/punk scene
a newcomer on the music scene
British players were finding it increasingly difficult to compete on the international scene.
Tarantino burst onto the cinema scene in the ’90s.
After years at the top, she just vanished from the scene.

senses.definition_vi: một lĩnh vực hoạt động hoặc lối sống cụ thể và những người tham gia vào đó

senses.definition: a view that you see

examples.x: a delightful rural scene
They went abroad for a change of scene (= to see and experience new surroundings).
We stood and surveyed the scene.
I stared out of the window of the train on the ever-changing scene.

senses.definition_vi: một cảnh tượng bạn nhìn thấy

senses.definition: a painting, drawing, or photograph of a place and the things that are happening there

examples.x: an exhibition of Parisian street scenes
He painted scenes of country life.

senses.definition_vi: một bức tranh, bản vẽ hoặc ảnh chụp về một địa điểm và những gì đang xảy ra ở đó

senses.definition: a loud, angry argument, especially one that happens in public and is embarrassing

examples.x: She had made a scene in the middle of the party.
‘Please leave,’ he said. ‘I don't want a scene.’

senses.definition_vi: một cuộc cãi vã lớn tiếng, giận dữ, đặc biệt là một cuộc cãi vã xảy ra ở nơi công cộng và gây xấu hổ

senses.definition: in the part of a theatre, etc. that the public does not usually see

examples.x: The students were able to go behind the scenes to see how programmes are made.

senses.definition_vi: trong phần của nhà hát, v.v. mà công chúng thường không nhìn thấy

senses.definition: in a way that people in general are not aware of

examples.x: A lot of negotiating has been going on behind the scenes.
behind-the-scenes work

senses.definition_vi: theo cách mà mọi người nói chung không nhận thức được

senses.definition: not the type of thing that somebody likes or enjoys doing

examples.x: Hillwalking is not my scene, so I stayed at home.

senses.definition_vi: không phải là loại điều mà ai đó thích hoặc thích làm

senses.definition: to create a situation in which something can easily happen or develop

examples.x: His arrival set the scene for another argument.

senses.definition_vi: tạo ra một tình huống mà điều gì đó có thể dễ dàng xảy ra hoặc phát triển

senses.definition: to give somebody the information and details they need in order to understand what comes next

examples.x: The first part of the programme was just setting the scene.
The scene is set in the first paragraph with an account of Sally's childhood.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp cho ai đó thông tin và chi tiết họ cần để hiểu những gì sắp xảy ra

senses.definition: having doubts that a claim or statement is true or that something will happen

examples.x: She looked highly sceptical.
I am sceptical about his chances of winning.
The public remain sceptical of these claims.

senses.definition_vi: có nghi ngờ rằng một tuyên bố hoặc lời nói là đúng hoặc rằng điều gì đó sẽ xảy ra

senses.definition: a plan that lists all the work that you have to do and when you must do each thing

examples.x: I have a hectic schedule for the next few days.
a busy/gruelling/punishing schedule
We're working to a tight schedule (= we have a lot of things to do in a short time).
He has taken some time out of his busy schedule to talk to us.
They have a very flexible work schedule.
I have no time available in my regular schedule.
Filming began on schedule (= at the planned time).
The project will be completed on schedule this summer.
The new bridge has been finished two years ahead of schedule.
The tunnel project has already fallen behind schedule.
At this stage everything is going according to schedule (= as planned).
We are trying desperately to keep to our schedule.
The countries have yet to set the schedule for the next round of talks.

senses.definition_vi: một kế hoạch liệt kê tất cả công việc bạn phải làm và khi nào bạn phải làm từng việc

senses.definition: a chart showing the times at which trains, buses and planes leave and arrive

examples.x: Connor checked the bus schedules for the day.
disruptions to flight schedules caused by the strike

senses.definition_vi: một biểu đồ hiển thị thời gian tàu hỏa, xe buýt và máy bay khởi hành và đến

senses.definition: a chart or plan of the classes that a student or teacher has in school each week

examples.x: Besides a full school schedule, Kayla's week is jam-packed with other activities.
What's your schedule like next semester?

senses.definition_vi: một biểu đồ hoặc kế hoạch về các lớp học mà một học sinh hoặc giáo viên có ở trường mỗi tuần

senses.definition: a list of the television and radio programmes that are on a particular channel and the times that they start

examples.x: The channel's schedules are filled with old films and repeats.
Channel 4 has published its spring schedules.
The show trebled ratings for the channel's afternoon schedule.

senses.definition_vi: một danh sách các chương trình truyền hình và radio trên một kênh cụ thể và thời gian bắt đầu của chúng

senses.definition: a written list of things, for example prices, rates or conditions

examples.x: tax schedules

senses.definition_vi: một danh sách bằng văn bản về các thứ, ví dụ như giá cả, tỷ lệ hoặc điều kiện

senses.definition: to arrange for something to happen at a particular time

examples.x: The meeting is scheduled for Friday afternoon.
Local elections were tentatively scheduled for November.
We scheduled regular status meetings.
One of the scheduled events is a talk on alternative medicine.
He finally arrived, an hour later than scheduled.
We'll be stopping here for longer than scheduled.
I'm scheduled to arrive in LA at 5 o'clock.
The talks were originally scheduled to begin in May.
The store is scheduled to open on Friday.
She is not scheduled to meet with any government officials during her trip.

senses.definition_vi: sắp xếp để một cái gì đó xảy ra vào một thời điểm cụ thể

senses.definition: to include something in an official list of things

examples.x: The substance has been scheduled as a poison.

senses.definition_vi: bao gồm một cái gì đó trong một danh sách chính thức các thứ

senses.definition: a plan or system for doing or organizing something

examples.x: a training scheme
a local scheme for recycling plastics
to introduce/operate a scheme to improve links between schools and industry
Under the new scheme only successful schools will be given extra funding.
to introduce/launch/run a scheme
a salary/insurance/loan scheme
The houses have been demolished as part of a major regeneration scheme.

senses.definition_vi: một kế hoạch hoặc hệ thống để làm hoặc tổ chức một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a plan for getting money or some other advantage for yourself, especially one that involves cheating other people

examples.x: an elaborate scheme to avoid taxes
They hatched a scheme to rob a Monte Carlo casino.
Is this another one of your crazy schemes for making money?

senses.definition_vi: một kế hoạch để kiếm tiền hoặc một số lợi thế khác cho bản thân, đặc biệt là một kế hoạch liên quan đến việc lừa gạt người khác

senses.definition: an ordered system or arrangement

examples.x: It is a poem with a rhyme scheme and a defined structure.

senses.definition_vi: một hệ thống hoặc sự sắp xếp có trật tự

senses.definition: an area of social housing (= houses or flats for people to rent or buy at low prices)

examples.x: I'm from Glasgow and grew up in a scheme.

senses.definition_vi: một khu nhà ở xã hội (= nhà hoặc căn hộ cho người thuê hoặc mua với giá thấp)

senses.definition: the way things seem to be organized; the way somebody wants everything to be organized

examples.x: My personal problems are not really important in the overall scheme of things.
This small annoyance isn't much in the grand scheme of things.
I don't think marriage figures in his scheme of things.

senses.definition_vi: cách mọi thứ dường như được tổ chức; cách ai đó muốn mọi thứ được tổ chức

senses.definition: a person who knows a lot about a particular subject because they have studied it in detail

examples.x: a classical scholar
He was the most distinguished scholar in his field.

senses.definition_vi: một người biết nhiều về một chủ đề cụ thể vì họ đã nghiên cứu nó một cách chi tiết

senses.definition: a student who has been given a scholarship to study at a school, college or university

examples.x: a Rhodes scholar

senses.definition_vi: một sinh viên đã nhận được học bổng để học tại một trường học, cao đẳng hoặc đại học

senses.definition: a clever person who works hard at school

examples.x: I was never much of a scholar.

senses.definition_vi: một người thông minh làm việc chăm chỉ ở trường
