These people have been living for years under the shadow of fear.

senses.definition_vi: sự ảnh hưởng mạnh mẽ (thường là xấu) của ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: dark areas under somebody’s eyes, because they are tired, etc.

examples.x: She looked pale, with deep shadows under her eyes.

senses.definition_vi: vùng tối dưới mắt ai đó, vì họ mệt mỏi, v.v.

senses.definition: a person or an animal that follows somebody else all the time
senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc một con vật luôn đi theo ai đó

senses.definition: a weaker or worse version of somebody/something

examples.x: So far this season the player has been a shadow of himself.
The result is a product that is a shadow of the real thing.

senses.definition_vi: một phiên bản yếu hơn hoặc tệ hơn của ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: a thing that is not real or possible to obtain

examples.x: You can't spend all your life chasing shadows.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ không có thật hoặc không thể đạt được

senses.definition: to be very easily frightened; to be very nervous
senses.definition_vi: rất dễ sợ hãi; rất lo lắng

senses.definition: to not have the strength, influence, etc. that you used to have

examples.x: When his career ended, he became a shadow of his former self.

senses.definition_vi: không còn sức mạnh, ảnh hưởng, v.v. như trước đây

senses.definition: very close to

examples.x: The new market is in the shadow of the City Hall.

senses.definition_vi: rất gần với

senses.definition: when you say that somebody is in/under the shadow of another person, you mean that they do not receive as much attention as that person

examples.x: A younger son often lives in the shadow of his elder brother.

senses.definition_vi: khi bạn nói rằng ai đó ở trong/dưới bóng của người khác, bạn có nghĩa là họ không nhận được nhiều sự chú ý như người đó

senses.definition: an act of shaking somebody/something

examples.x: She gave him a shake to wake him.
Give the bottle a good shake before opening.
He dismissed the idea with a firm shake of his head (= turning it from side to side to mean ‘no’).

senses.definition_vi: một hành động lắc ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: a physical condition in which you cannot stop your body from shaking because of fear, illness, or because you have drunk too much alcohol

examples.x: I always get the shakes before exams.

senses.definition_vi: một tình trạng thể chất mà bạn không thể ngừng cơ thể mình run rẩy vì sợ hãi, bệnh tật, hoặc vì bạn đã uống quá nhiều rượu

senses.definition: a drink made of milk, and sometimes ice cream, with the added taste of fruit or chocolate, which is mixed or shaken until it is full of bubbles

examples.x: a strawberry shake

senses.definition_vi: một loại đồ uống làm từ sữa, và đôi khi là kem, có thêm hương vị trái cây hoặc sô cô la, được trộn hoặc lắc cho đến khi sủi bọt

senses.definition: to be not very good, efficient, suitable, etc.
senses.definition_vi: không rất tốt, hiệu quả, phù hợp, v.v.

senses.definition: (to give somebody/get) fair treatment that gives you the same chance as somebody else

examples.x: Are minority students getting a fair shake at college?
We need a government that cares about equity and a fair go for all.

senses.definition_vi: (cho ai đó/nhận được) sự đối xử công bằng mang lại cho bạn cơ hội như người khác

senses.definition: very soon

examples.x: We’ll be there in a couple of shakes.

senses.definition_vi: rất sớm

senses.definition: to move or make somebody/something move with short quick movements from side to side or up and down

examples.x: The whole house shakes when a train goes past.
Shake the bottle well before use.
The explosion shook windows miles from the site.
She shook him by the shoulders.
He knelt and gently shook her awake.
She shook her hair loose.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển hoặc làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó di chuyển bằng những cử động ngắn, nhanh từ bên này sang bên kia hoặc từ trên xuống dưới

senses.definition: to move something in a particular direction by shaking

examples.x: She bent down to shake a pebble out of her shoe.
His father used to come home and shake the dust off his work clothes.
He stood up, shaking sand everywhere.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển một cái gì đó theo một hướng cụ thể bằng cách lắc

senses.definition: to take somebody’s hand and move it up and down as a way of saying hello or to show that you agree about something

examples.x: Do people in Italy shake hands when they meet?
She refused to shake hands with him.
He stepped forward and shook my hand.
Our host shook each of us warmly by the hand.
They shook hands on the deal (= to show that they had reached an agreement).
They shook on the deal (= shook hands to show the deal was agreed).
Let's shake on it.

senses.definition_vi: nắm tay ai đó và di chuyển nó lên xuống như một cách chào hỏi hoặc để thể hiện sự đồng ý về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to turn your head from side to side as a way of saying ‘no’ or to show that you are sad, feel doubt, etc.

examples.x: ‘Drink?’ he offered. She shook her head.
The old man watched them walk off into the night, shaking his head sadly.
She shook her head in disbelief.
He shook his head at the thought.

senses.definition_vi: quay đầu từ bên này sang bên kia như một cách nói 'không' hoặc để thể hiện sự buồn bã, nghi ngờ, v.v.

senses.definition: to show that you are angry with somebody; to threaten somebody by shaking your fist (= closed hand)

examples.x: The man shook his fist at the court after he was sentenced.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện sự tức giận với ai đó; đe dọa ai đó bằng cách giơ nắm đấm (= bàn tay nắm chặt) của bạn

senses.definition: to make short quick movements that you cannot control, for example because you are cold or afraid

examples.x: Her hands had started to shake.
He was shaking with fear.
He saw his mother turn away, her shoulders shaking with laughter.
His whole body shook with rage.
I was shaking like a leaf.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho cử động ngắn, nhanh mà bạn không thể kiểm soát, ví dụ vì bạn bị lạnh hoặc sợ hãi

senses.definition: to sound unsteady, usually because you are nervous, upset or angry

examples.x: ‘Who are you?’ he asked, his voice shaking.
Her voice shook with emotion.

senses.definition_vi: nghe không vững, thường là vì bạn đang lo lắng, buồn bã hoặc tức giận

senses.definition: to shock or upset somebody very much

examples.x: He was badly shaken by the news of her death.
The accident really shook her up.
Shaken up by the early goal against them, the team began to fight back.

senses.definition_vi: gây sốc hoặc làm ai đó rất buồn

senses.definition: to make a belief or an idea less certain

examples.x: The incident had shaken her faith in him.
This announcement is bound to shake the confidence of the industry.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho một niềm tin hoặc một ý tưởng kém chắc chắn hơn

senses.definition: to get rid of something

examples.x: I can't seem to shake off this cold.
She has finally managed to shake off her old wrist injury.
He couldn't shake the feeling that there was something wrong.
She never seemed to completely shake off the dumb blonde image.

senses.definition_vi: tống khứ cái gì đó

senses.definition: to cause people to question their basic beliefs about something

examples.x: This issue has shaken the foundations of French politics.
an event which rocked the foundations of British politics
The scandal rocked the legal establishment to its foundations.

senses.definition_vi: khiến mọi người đặt câu hỏi về những niềm tin cơ bản của họ về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to be very frightened or nervous
senses.definition_vi: rất sợ hãi hoặc lo lắng

senses.definition: used to tell somebody to start to do something or to hurry
senses.definition_vi: dùng để yêu cầu ai đó bắt đầu làm gì đó hoặc nhanh lên

senses.definition: used with I and we for talking about or predicting the future

examples.x: This time next week I shall be in Scotland.
We shan't be gone long.
I said that I should be pleased to help.

senses.definition_vi: dùng với 'I' và 'we' để nói về hoặc dự đoán tương lai

senses.definition: used in questions with I and we for making offers or suggestions or asking advice

examples.x: Shall I send you the book?
What shall we do this weekend?
Let's look at it again, shall we?

senses.definition_vi: dùng trong câu hỏi với 'I' và 'we' để đưa ra lời đề nghị hoặc gợi ý hoặc hỏi lời khuyên

senses.definition: used to show that you are determined, or to give an order or instruction

examples.x: He is determined that you shall succeed.
Candidates shall remain in their seats until all the papers have been collected.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để thể hiện rằng bạn quyết tâm, hoặc để đưa ra mệnh lệnh hoặc chỉ dẫn

senses.definition: not having much distance between the top or surface and the bottom

examples.x: a shallow dish/pan/bowl
a shallow sea/lake/pool/pond
They were playing in the shallow end (= of the swimming pool).
These fish are found in shallow waters around the coast.
The body was found in a shallow grave.
Most earthquakes occur at much shallower depths.
shallow roots (= that grow near the surface of the ground)

senses.definition_vi: không có nhiều khoảng cách giữa bề mặt trên cùng và đáy

senses.definition: not showing serious thought, feelings, etc. about something

examples.x: This shows how shallow their commitment to the environment really is.
Tony seemed very shallow and immature.

senses.definition_vi: không thể hiện suy nghĩ, cảm xúc nghiêm túc, v.v. về điều gì đó

senses.definition: shallow breathing involves taking in only a small amount of air each time
senses.definition_vi: thở nông liên quan đến việc hít vào chỉ một lượng không khí nhỏ mỗi lần

senses.definition: used to say that something is a cause for feeling sad or disappointed

examples.x: She's retiring because of ill health, which is a great shame.
What happened was a real shame.
It's a shame that she wasn't here to see it.
Shame they didn't think of that earlier.
It’s a shame (that) you didn’t say something sooner.
What a shame they couldn't come.
It's a shame about Tim, isn't it?
It's a terrible shame about Stuart losing his job, isn't it?
It's a shame to see her wasting her talent like this.

examples.cf: shame for somebody/something to do something
examples.x: It'd be a shame for us to give up now.
It would be a crying shame (= a great shame) not to take them up on the offer.
It seems such a shame to throw perfectly good food away.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó là nguyên nhân gây buồn hoặc thất vọng

senses.definition: the feelings of being sad, embarrassed or guilty that you have when you know that something you have done is wrong or stupid

examples.x: His face burned with shame.
They should blush with shame.
She hung her head in shame.
The king preferred death to the shame of defeat.
It took me a while to get over the shame of not doing something to help him.
He could not live with the shame of other people knowing the truth.
I felt a twinge of shame at the thought.
She admitted her shame at having a parent in prison.
He was filled with shame for giving in to his anger.
She expressed her shame for her role in the whole unfortunate business.
I would die of shame if she ever found out.
To my shame (= I feel shame that) I refused to listen to her side of the story.

senses.definition_vi: những cảm giác buồn bã, bối rối hoặc tội lỗi mà bạn có khi biết rằng điều gì đó bạn đã làm là sai hoặc ngu ngốc

senses.definition: the ability to feel shame at something you have done

examples.x: Have you no shame?
That child is completely without shame!
She has no sense of shame.

senses.definition_vi: khả năng cảm thấy xấu hổ về điều gì đó bạn đã làm

senses.definition: the loss of respect that is caused when you do something wrong or stupid

examples.x: There is no shame in wanting to be successful.
She felt that her failure would bring shame on her family.
He risked public shame and possible imprisonment.

senses.definition_vi: sự mất mát sự tôn trọng gây ra khi bạn làm điều gì đó sai hoặc ngu ngốc

senses.definition: to be much better than somebody/something

examples.x: Their presentation put ours to shame.
Her energy and enthusiasm puts the rest of us to shame (= makes us feel embarrassed and guilty that we are not the same).

senses.definition_vi: tốt hơn nhiều so với ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: used to say that somebody should feel ashamed for something they have said or done

examples.x: Shame on you for doubting me!

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng ai đó nên cảm thấy xấu hổ vì điều gì đó họ đã nói hoặc làm

senses.definition: the form of the outer edges or surfaces of something; an example of something that has a particular form

examples.x: a rectangular/spherical/cylindrical shape
geometric shapes
fantastic creatures that can change shape and be either visible or invisible
You can recognize the fish by the shape of their fins.
They have completely different body shapes.
This old T-shirt has completely lost its shape.
The island was originally circular in shape.
Several rooms are irregular in shape.
Candles come in all shapes and sizes.
Glass is blown or moulded into many shapes.
The pool was in the shape of a heart.
The government provides money in the shape of (= consisting of) grants and student loans.

senses.definition_vi: hình thức của các cạnh hoặc bề mặt ngoài của một vật; một ví dụ về thứ có một hình thức cụ thể

senses.definition: a person or thing that is difficult to see clearly

examples.x: Ghostly shapes moved around in the dark.
I could just make out a dark shape in the distance.
An enormous shape loomed up out of the mist directly in front of me.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật khó nhìn rõ

senses.definition: the physical condition of somebody/something

examples.x: What sort of shape was the car in after the accident?
He's in good shape for someone who had surgery six months ago.
The ship was in bad shape as a result of damage sustained in the collision.
He’s not in any shape (= not well enough) to be working.

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng thể chất của ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: the particular qualities or characteristics of something

examples.x: Will new technology change the shape of broadcasting?
Prices vary according to the size and shape of each project.
He did much to determine the shape of Asia's political map.

senses.definition_vi: những phẩm chất hoặc đặc điểm cụ thể của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to become angry, anxious or upset

examples.x: Don't get bent out of shape about it. It was just a mistake!

senses.definition_vi: trở nên tức giận, lo lắng hoặc buồn bã

senses.definition: to take exercise, eat healthy food, etc. in order to become physically fit

examples.x: I’m trying to get into shape before summer.
I need to get back into shape after the Christmas holiday.

senses.definition_vi: tập thể dục, ăn thực phẩm lành mạnh, v.v. để trở nên cân đối về thể chất

senses.definition: to train somebody so that they do a particular job, task, etc. well

examples.x: It took him just two weeks to knock the new recruits into shape.

senses.definition_vi: huấn luyện ai đó để họ làm tốt một công việc, nhiệm vụ, v.v. cụ thể

senses.definition: to make something more acceptable, organized or successful

examples.x: I've got all the information together but it still needs knocking into shape.
It shouldn’t take long to get the company back into shape.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho một cái gì đó trở nên dễ chấp nhận hơn, có tổ chức hơn hoặc thành công hơn

senses.definition: to express or explain a particular idea, plan, etc.

examples.x: Marie tried to find the right words to give shape to the confusion in her head.

senses.definition_vi: diễn đạt hoặc giải thích một ý tưởng, kế hoạch, v.v. cụ thể

senses.definition: of any type

examples.x: I don't approve of violence in any shape or form.
I can't stand insects in any shape or form.
I do not condone bullying in any way, shape or form.

senses.definition_vi: bất kỳ loại nào

senses.definition: (to get/stay) in good physical condition

examples.x: You don't have to spend a fortune on gym membership to get in shape.
I like to stay in shape.

senses.definition_vi: ở trong tình trạng thể chất tốt

senses.definition: not having the normal shape

examples.x: The wheel had been twisted out of shape.
The bicycle had been battered out of shape.

senses.definition_vi: không có hình dạng bình thường

senses.definition: not in good physical condition

examples.x: I didn’t realize how out of shape I was!

senses.definition_vi: không ở trong tình trạng thể chất tốt

senses.definition: the way things are likely to develop in the future

examples.x: Are solar-powered cars the shape of things to come?
This new system could be the shape of things to come.

senses.definition_vi: cách mọi thứ có khả năng phát triển trong tương lai

senses.definition: to develop and become more complete or organized

examples.x: The garden is beginning to take shape.
A new song began to take shape in her mind.

senses.definition_vi: phát triển và trở nên hoàn chỉnh hoặc có tổ chức hơn

senses.definition: to dance

examples.x: She spent the whole evening throwing shapes on the dance floor.

senses.definition_vi: nhảy múa

senses.definition: to behave in a way that makes you seem to threaten somebody, especially by standing as though you are ready to fight, without actually becoming violent

examples.x: I was worried he might get violent but he was just throwing shapes.
The two main investors threw some shapes during the debate.

senses.definition_vi: hành xử theo cách khiến bạn có vẻ đe dọa ai đó, đặc biệt là bằng cách đứng như thể bạn sẵn sàng chiến đấu, mà không thực sự trở nên bạo lực

senses.definition: to make something into a particular shape

examples.x: Shape the dough into a ball.
The man was busy shaping mud into bricks.
This tool is used for shaping wood.
They use traditional methods to shape the stone.
tools for cutting and shaping metal

senses.definition_vi: làm cho một cái gì đó thành một hình dạng cụ thể

senses.definition: to have an important influence on the way that somebody/something develops

examples.x: You are helping to shape the future of this country.
She had a leading role in shaping party policy.
the historical circumstances that shaped their lives.
His ideas had been shaped by his experiences during the war.

senses.definition_vi: có ảnh hưởng quan trọng đến cách ai đó/cái gì đó phát triển

senses.definition: to prepare to do something, especially hit or kick something

examples.x: She was shaping to hit her second shot.

senses.definition_vi: chuẩn bị làm điều gì đó, đặc biệt là đánh hoặc đá một vật gì đó

senses.definition: used to tell somebody that if they do not improve, work harder, etc. they will have to leave their job, position, etc.

examples.x: He finally faced up to his drug problem when his band told him to shape up or ship out.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói với ai đó rằng nếu họ không cải thiện, làm việc chăm chỉ hơn, v.v. họ sẽ phải rời bỏ công việc, vị trí, v.v. của mình.

senses.definition: having the type of shape mentioned

examples.x: a huge balloon shaped like a giant cow
almond-shaped eyes
an L-shaped room

senses.definition_vi: có loại hình dạng được đề cập.

senses.definition: one part of something that is divided between two or more people

examples.x: Next year we hope to have a greater share of the market.
The charity was supposed to have been given a share of the profits.
The party won its biggest share of the vote since 1992.
The new TV channel has continued to increase its share of advertising revenue.
The three hospitals will each receive an equal share of the money raised.
Why should he be entitled to a larger share of the royalties?
How much was your share of the winnings?
I have a 50 per cent share in the business.
If you die before your husband, your share in the property may go directly to your children.
I'm looking for a flat share (= a flat that is shared by two or more people who are not related).

senses.definition_vi: một phần của một cái gì đó được chia cho hai hoặc nhiều người.

senses.definition: the part that somebody has in a particular activity that involves several people

examples.x: We all did our share.
Everyone must accept their share of the blame.
Churchill bore a huge share of the responsibility for this failure.
We must all do our share of the work.

senses.definition_vi: phần mà ai đó có trong một hoạt động cụ thể liên quan đến nhiều người.

senses.definition: an amount of something that is thought to be normal or acceptable for one person or thing

examples.x: He always eats more than his share.
I've had my share of luck in the past.
I've done my share of worrying for one day!
The industry has had its share of problems this year.
a branch of literature which has yet to receive its full share of attention
It is right to pay your full share of tax.

senses.definition_vi: một lượng của một cái gì đó được coi là bình thường hoặc chấp nhận được cho một người hoặc một vật.

senses.definition: the action of sending on a message on social media for other people to see

examples.x: The campaign has already received 180 000 shares on Facebook.

senses.definition_vi: hành động gửi một tin nhắn trên mạng xã hội để người khác xem.

senses.definition: any of the units of equal value into which a company is divided that are sold to raise money. People who own shares receive part of the company’s profits.

examples.x: to have/hold/own shares
to buy/sell/trade shares
The company purchased 5.5m shares of the stock this week.
The company's shares fell 4.37 per cent.
Earnings per share are growing.
They acquired shares in the company earlier this year.
a fall in share prices
70% of our share capital is in the hands of international investors.
a share certificate
The airline's shares closed (= finished trading for the day) up 8p at 171p.

senses.definition_vi: bất kỳ đơn vị nào có giá trị bằng nhau mà một công ty được chia thành và được bán để huy động vốn. Những người sở hữu cổ phiếu nhận được một phần lợi nhuận của công ty.

senses.definition: the broad curved blade (= metal cutting edge) of a plough
senses.definition_vi: lưỡi cắt cong rộng (= cạnh cắt kim loại) của một cái cày.

senses.definition: (more than) an amount of something that is considered to be reasonable or acceptable

examples.x: He has more than his fair share of problems.
I've had my fair share of success in the past.

senses.definition_vi: (nhiều hơn) một lượng của một cái gì đó được coi là hợp lý hoặc có thể chấp nhận được.

senses.definition: the largest or best part of something when it is divided
senses.definition_vi: phần lớn nhất hoặc tốt nhất của một cái gì đó khi nó được chia.

senses.definition: a share of the available money or benefits that you believe you have a right to

examples.x: Scotland is demanding a larger share of the national cake.

senses.definition_vi: một phần tiền hoặc lợi ích có sẵn mà bạn tin rằng mình có quyền hưởng.

senses.definition: to have, use or experience something at the same time as somebody else

examples.x: There isn't an empty table. Would you mind sharing?
to share a room/bed
Parents said there was insufficient room for the two schools to share space.
It's been 23 years since these four men shared a stage.
Sue shares a house with three other students.
Bob told Jess he wanted to share his life with her.

senses.definition_vi: có, sử dụng hoặc trải nghiệm một cái gì đó cùng lúc với người khác.

senses.definition: to have part of something while another person or other people also have part

examples.x: All members of the band equally share the band's profits.
He shared the pie with her.
The Hungarian king shared power with the Austrian emperor to form the Austro-Hungarian Empire.
Each partner is entitled to share in the profits of the business.

senses.definition_vi: có một phần của một cái gì đó trong khi người khác hoặc những người khác cũng có một phần.

senses.definition: to divide something between two or more people

examples.x: We shared the pizza between the four of us.
Rita shared her money out among her six grandchildren.
Profits are shared out yearly.

senses.definition_vi: chia một cái gì đó giữa hai hoặc nhiều người.

senses.definition: to give some of what you have to somebody else; to let somebody use something that is yours

examples.x: John had no brothers or sisters and wasn't used to sharing.
The conference is a good place to share information and exchange ideas.
This online resource will give farmers a new way to share knowledge with each other.
Eli shared his chocolate with the other kids.

senses.definition_vi: cho đi một phần những gì bạn có cho người khác; cho phép người khác sử dụng thứ gì đó của bạn.

senses.definition: to have the same feelings, ideas, experiences, etc. as somebody else

examples.x: to share a concern/an opinion
shared values
They shared a common interest in botany.
a view that is widely shared
They share a love of cinema.
His son doesn't share his passion for athletics.
We share many beliefs with followers of other religions.
People often share their political views with their parents.
I didn't really share in her love of animals.

senses.definition_vi: có cùng cảm xúc, ý tưởng, kinh nghiệm, v.v. với người khác.

senses.definition: to tell other people about your ideas, experiences, and feelings

examples.x: to share thoughts/ideas/feelings/memories
I did not find it easy to share my problems.
The two friends shared everything—they had no secrets.
Please share this on social media so we can get the word out.
I want to share the stories of several people I met.
Think of this as an opportunity to share your experiences.
The group listens while one person shares (= tells other people about their experiences, feelings, etc.).
Would you like to share your experience with the rest of the group?

senses.definition_vi: nói cho người khác biết về ý tưởng, kinh nghiệm và cảm xúc của bạn.

senses.definition: to be equally involved in something or responsible for something

examples.x: Both drivers shared the blame for the accident.
Don't try to do everything yourself: you will need to share the load with your partner.

examples.cf: be shared between A and B
examples.x: Responsibility is shared between parents and teachers.
I try to get the kids to share in the housework.

senses.definition_vi: cùng tham gia vào một việc gì đó hoặc chịu trách nhiệm về một việc gì đó.

senses.definition: used to say that everyone should share things equally and in a fair way
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng mọi người nên chia sẻ mọi thứ một cách bình đẳng và công bằng.

senses.definition: if you talk to somebody about your problems and worries, instead of keeping them to yourself, they seem less serious
senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói chuyện với ai đó về những rắc rối và lo lắng của mình, thay vì giữ chúng cho riêng mình, chúng dường như ít nghiêm trọng hơn.

senses.definition: an owner of shares in a company or business

examples.x: the major shareholders in the company

senses.definition_vi: chủ sở hữu cổ phiếu của một công ty hoặc doanh nghiệp.

senses.definition: having a fine edge or point, especially of something that can cut or make a hole in something

examples.x: a sharp knife
Toys with sharp edges are not suitable for young children.
sharp teeth
Take a sheet of paper and a sharp pencil.

senses.definition_vi: có cạnh hoặc điểm sắc, đặc biệt là của một vật có thể cắt hoặc tạo lỗ trên vật khác.

senses.definition: sudden, rapid and large

examples.x: a sharp drop in prices
a sharp rise in crime
a sharp increase in unemployment
the sharp decline in the value of the pound against the dollar
He heard a sharp intake of breath.
We need to give young criminals a short, sharp shock (= a punishment that is very unpleasant for a short time).

senses.definition_vi: đột ngột, nhanh chóng và lớn.

senses.definition: clear and definite

examples.x: a sharp outline
The photograph is not very sharp (= there are no clear contrasts between areas of light and shade).
She drew a sharp distinction between domestic and international politics.
In sharp contrast to her mood, the clouds were breaking up to reveal a blue sky.
The issue must be brought into sharper focus.
The image looks very sharp and nicely detailed.

senses.definition_vi: rõ ràng và dứt khoát.

senses.definition: quick to notice or understand things or to react

examples.x: to have sharp eyes
a girl of sharp intelligence
a sharp sense of humour
He kept a sharp lookout for any strangers.
It was very sharp of you to see that!
Her mind was as sharp as a razor.

senses.definition_vi: nhanh chóng nhận thấy hoặc hiểu mọi thứ hoặc phản ứng.

senses.definition: critical or severe

examples.x: sharp criticism
Emma has a sharp tongue (= she often speaks in an unpleasant or unkind way).
He was very sharp with me when I was late.

senses.definition_vi: chỉ trích hoặc nghiêm khắc.

senses.definition: loud, sudden and often high in tone

examples.x: She read out the list in sharp, clipped tones.
There was a sharp knock on the door.

senses.definition_vi: to, đột ngột và thường có âm vực cao.

senses.definition: very strong and sudden, often like being cut or badly hurt

examples.x: He winced as a sharp pain shot through his leg.
Polly felt a sharp pang of jealousy.

senses.definition_vi: rất mạnh và đột ngột, thường giống như bị cắt hoặc bị thương nặng.

senses.definition: changing direction suddenly

examples.x: a sharp bend in the road
a sharp turn to the left

senses.definition_vi: thay đổi hướng đột ngột.

senses.definition: strong and slightly bitter

examples.x: The cheese has a distinctively sharp taste.

senses.definition_vi: mạnh và hơi đắng.

senses.definition: used to describe a very cold or very severe frost or wind
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mô tả sương giá hoặc gió rất lạnh hoặc rất khắc nghiệt.

senses.definition: clever but possibly dishonest

examples.x: His lawyer's a sharp operator.
The firm had to face some sharp practice from competing companies.

senses.definition_vi: thông minh nhưng có thể không trung thực.

senses.definition: fashionable and new

examples.x: The consultants were a group of men in sharp suits.
Todd is a sharp dresser.

senses.definition_vi: hợp thời trang và mới.

senses.definition: not full or round in shape

examples.x: a man with a thin face and sharp features (= a pointed nose and chin)

senses.definition_vi: không đầy hoặc tròn về hình dạng.

senses.definition: used after the name of a note to mean a note a semitone higher

examples.x: the Piano Sonata in C sharp minor

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng sau tên của một nốt nhạc để chỉ một nốt cao hơn một nửa cung.

senses.definition: above the correct pitch (= how high or low a note sounds)

examples.x: That note sounded sharp.

senses.definition_vi: cao hơn cao độ chuẩn (= âm thanh cao hay thấp của một nốt nhạc).

senses.definition: not intelligent

examples.x: He's not exactly the sharpest knife in the drawer, is he?

senses.definition_vi: không thông minh.

senses.definition: the place or position of greatest difficulty or responsibility

examples.x: He started work at the sharp end of the business, as a salesman.

senses.definition_vi: nơi hoặc vị trí có khó khăn hoặc trách nhiệm lớn nhất.

senses.definition: to suddenly break into small pieces; to make something suddenly break into small pieces

examples.x: He dropped the vase and it shattered into pieces on the floor.
The mirror shattered into a thousand pieces.
the sound of shattering glass
The explosion shattered all the windows in the building.

senses.definition_vi: đột ngột vỡ thành nhiều mảnh nhỏ; làm cho một cái gì đó đột ngột vỡ thành nhiều mảnh nhỏ.

senses.definition: to destroy something completely, especially somebody’s feelings, hopes or beliefs; to be destroyed in this way

examples.x: Anna's self-confidence had been completely shattered.
Injury shattered his dreams of competing in the Olympics.
Her experience of divorce shattered her illusions about love.
My whole world shattered into a million pieces.

senses.definition_vi: phá hủy hoàn toàn một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là tình cảm, hy vọng hoặc niềm tin của ai đó; bị phá hủy theo cách này.

senses.definition: to make somebody feel extremely shocked and upset

examples.x: The unexpected death of their son shattered them.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy cực kỳ sốc và đau khổ

senses.definition: a female person or animal that has already been mentioned or is easily identified

examples.x: ‘What does your sister do?’ ‘She's a dentist.’
Doesn't she (= the woman we are looking at) look like Sue?
Think about a friend or family member. What kind of person is he or she?

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc động vật giống cái đã được đề cập trước đó hoặc dễ dàng nhận biết

senses.definition: it (used to refer to something not usually thought of as female)

examples.x: She's a big country.

senses.definition_vi: nó (được sử dụng để chỉ một thứ gì đó không thường được coi là giống cái)

senses.definition: to get rid of something that is no longer wanted

examples.x: The factory is shedding a large number of jobs.
a quick way to shed unwanted pounds (= extra weight or fat on your body)
Museums have been trying hard to shed their stuffy image.

senses.definition_vi: loại bỏ thứ gì đó không còn cần thiết

senses.definition: to take off a piece of clothing

examples.x: We shed our jackets.
Luke shed his clothes onto the floor.

senses.definition_vi: cởi bỏ một món quần áo

senses.definition: to lose or drop what it is carrying

examples.x: The traffic jam was caused by a lorry shedding its load.

senses.definition_vi: mất hoặc rơi thứ nó đang mang

senses.definition: if an animal sheds its skin, or a plant sheds leaves, it loses them naturally

examples.x: How often does a snake shed its skin?
trees that shed their leaves in autumn

senses.definition_vi: nếu một con vật rụng da, hoặc một cây rụng lá, nó sẽ mất chúng một cách tự nhiên

senses.definition: to send light over something; to let light fall somewhere

examples.x: The candles shed a soft glow on her face.

senses.definition_vi: tỏa ánh sáng lên cái gì đó; để ánh sáng chiếu xuống đâu đó

senses.definition: to cry

examples.x: She shed no tears when she heard he was dead.

senses.definition_vi: khóc

senses.definition: to kill or injure people, especially in a war

examples.x: How much blood will be shed before the fighting ends?

senses.definition_vi: giết hoặc làm bị thương người, đặc biệt là trong chiến tranh

senses.definition: to have the quality of causing water or liquid to run off and not sink in

examples.x: A duck's feathers shed water immediately.

senses.definition_vi: có đặc tính làm cho nước hoặc chất lỏng chảy đi và không thấm vào

senses.definition: to make a problem, etc. easier to understand

examples.x: Recent research has shed new light on the causes of the disease.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho một vấn đề, v.v. dễ hiểu hơn

senses.definition: an animal with a thick coat, kept on farms for its meat (called mutton or lamb) or its wool

examples.x: a flock of sheep
Sheep were grazing in the fields.
sheep farmers
These leaves are toxic to cattle and sheep.

senses.definition_vi: một loài động vật có bộ lông dày, được nuôi trong các trang trại để lấy thịt (gọi là thịt cừu hoặc thịt cừu non) hoặc len của nó

senses.definition: to imagine that sheep are jumping over a fence and to count them, as a way of getting to sleep
senses.definition_vi: tưởng tượng cừu nhảy qua hàng rào và đếm chúng, như một cách để đi vào giấc ngủ

senses.definition: if people behave like sheep, they all do what the others are doing, without thinking for themselves
senses.definition_vi: nếu mọi người cư xử như cừu, họ đều làm những gì người khác đang làm, mà không suy nghĩ cho bản thân

senses.definition: if you are going to be punished for doing something wrong, whether it is a big or small thing, you may as well do the big thing
senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn sắp bị phạt vì làm điều gì đó sai trái, dù là việc lớn hay nhỏ, bạn cũng nên làm việc lớn

senses.definition: to recognize the difference between people who are good at something, intelligent, etc. and those who are not
senses.definition_vi: nhận ra sự khác biệt giữa những người giỏi trong một lĩnh vực nào đó, thông minh, v.v. và những người không phải

senses.definition: a person who seems to be friendly or not likely to cause any harm but is really an enemy
senses.definition_vi: một người có vẻ thân thiện hoặc không có khả năng gây hại nhưng thực chất là kẻ thù

senses.definition: used to emphasize the size, degree or amount of something

examples.x: The area is under threat from the sheer number of tourists using it.
We were impressed by the sheer size of the cathedral.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh quy mô, mức độ hoặc số lượng của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: complete and not mixed with anything else

examples.x: The concert was sheer delight.
sheer luck/chance/coincidence/joy/bliss/determination
I only agreed out of sheer desperation.
sheer terror/panic/exhaustion/hell

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn và không pha trộn với bất cứ thứ gì khác

senses.definition: very steep

examples.x: sheer cliffs/slopes
Outside there was a sheer drop down to the sea below.

senses.definition_vi: rất dốc

senses.definition: thin, light and almost transparent

examples.x: sheer nylon

senses.definition_vi: mỏng, nhẹ và gần như trong suốt

senses.definition: a large piece of thin cloth used on a bed to lie on or lie under

examples.x: Have you changed the sheets (= put clean sheets on the bed)?
He slid between the sheets and closed his eyes.
white bed sheets

senses.definition_vi: một tấm vải lớn, mỏng dùng trên giường để nằm lên hoặc nằm dưới

senses.definition: a piece of paper for writing or printing on, etc. usually in a standard size

examples.x: a clean/blank sheet of paper (= with no writing on it)
a sheet of A4
Start each answer on a fresh sheet.
Pick up one of our free information sheets at reception.

senses.definition_vi: một tờ giấy để viết hoặc in, v.v., thường có kích thước tiêu chuẩn

senses.definition: a flat thin piece of any material, normally square or rectangular

examples.x: a sheet of glass/plastic/plywood/steel
sheet metal (= metal that has been made into thin sheets)

senses.definition_vi: một miếng phẳng, mỏng của bất kỳ vật liệu nào, thường có hình vuông hoặc hình chữ nhật

senses.definition: a wide flat area of something, covering the surface of something else

examples.x: The road was covered with a sheet of ice.

senses.definition_vi: một khu vực rộng, phẳng của một cái gì đó, bao phủ bề mặt của một cái gì đó khác

senses.definition: a large moving mass of fire or water

examples.x: a sheet of flame
The rain was coming down in sheets (= very heavily).

senses.definition_vi: một khối lửa hoặc nước lớn đang di chuyển

senses.definition: a rope or chain fastened to the lower corner of a sail to hold it and to control the angle of the sail
senses.definition_vi: một sợi dây hoặc dây xích được gắn vào góc dưới của cánh buồm để giữ nó và kiểm soát góc của cánh buồm

senses.definition: a record of your work or behaviour that does not show any mistakes or bad things that you have done

examples.x: No government operates with a completely clean sheet.
They kept a clean sheet in the match (= no goals were scored against them).

senses.definition_vi: một bản ghi lại công việc hoặc hành vi của bạn mà không cho thấy bất kỳ sai lầm hoặc điều tồi tệ nào bạn đã làm

senses.definition: a flat board, made of wood, metal, glass, etc., fixed to the wall or forming part of a cupboard, bookcase, etc., for things to be placed on

examples.x: I helped him put up some shelves in his bedroom.
The book I wanted was on the top shelf.
supermarket shelves
store shelves
The product should hit store shelves by August.
library shelves
empty shelves
the powerful retailers who control what products get shelf space

senses.definition_vi: một tấm phẳng, làm bằng gỗ, kim loại, kính, v.v., gắn vào tường hoặc là một phần của tủ, kệ sách, v.v., để đặt đồ lên

senses.definition: a thing like a shelf in shape, especially a piece of rock sticking out from a cliff or from the edge of a mass of land under the sea
senses.definition_vi: một vật có hình dạng giống kệ, đặc biệt là một mỏm đá nhô ra từ vách đá hoặc từ mép của một khối đất dưới biển

senses.definition: that can be bought immediately and does not have to be specially designed or ordered

examples.x: I bought this package off the shelf.
Some courses can be bought off the shelf as self-contained study packages.

senses.definition_vi: có thể mua ngay lập tức và không cần phải thiết kế hoặc đặt hàng đặc biệt

senses.definition: not wanted by anyone; not used
senses.definition_vi: không ai muốn; không được sử dụng

senses.definition: considered unlikely to get married or find a partner, because of being too old
senses.definition_vi: được coi là khó kết hôn hoặc tìm được bạn đời, vì đã quá già

senses.definition: to stop something from being sold

examples.x: The slimming pills were taken off the market.
Thousands of egg products were taken off the shelves following the health scare.

senses.definition_vi: ngừng bán một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the hard outer part of eggs, nuts, some seeds, and some animals

examples.x: We collected shells on the beach.
snail/oyster/clam shells
walnut shells
earrings made out of coconut shell
the shell of a turtle

senses.definition_vi: phần cứng bên ngoài của trứng, hạt, một số hạt và một số động vật

senses.definition: any object that looks like the shell of a snail or sea creature

examples.x: pasta shells

senses.definition_vi: bất kỳ vật thể nào trông giống vỏ sò ốc hoặc sinh vật biển

senses.definition: a metal case filled with explosive, to be fired from a large gun

examples.x: mortar/artillery shells
A shell burst only yards away from us.
Several empty shell casings were found in the area.

senses.definition_vi: một vỏ kim loại chứa đầy chất nổ, để bắn từ một khẩu súng lớn

senses.definition: a tube or case containing explosive and a bullet or shot, for shooting from a gun
senses.definition_vi: một ống hoặc vỏ chứa đầy chất nổ và một viên đạn hoặc hạt, để bắn từ súng

senses.definition: the walls or outer structure of something, for example, an empty building or ship after a fire or a bomb attack

examples.x: The house was now a shell gutted by flames.
My life has been an empty shell since he died.
The fire reduced the school to a hollow shell.

senses.definition_vi: các bức tường hoặc cấu trúc bên ngoài của một cái gì đó, ví dụ, một tòa nhà hoặc con tàu trống rỗng sau một vụ hỏa hoạn hoặc một cuộc tấn công bằng bom

senses.definition: any structure that forms a hard outer frame

examples.x: the body shell of a car

senses.definition_vi: bất kỳ cấu trúc nào tạo thành một khung cứng bên ngoài

senses.definition: the outer layer of somebody’s personality; how they seem to be or feel

examples.x: She had developed a shell of indifference.
She had built up a protective shell around herself.

senses.definition_vi: lớp ngoài cùng trong tính cách của ai đó; cách họ tỏ ra hoặc cảm thấy

senses.definition: to become less shy and more confident when talking to other people

examples.x: He’s really come out of his shell since he met Marie.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên bớt nhút nhát và tự tin hơn khi nói chuyện với người khác

senses.definition: to become shyer and avoid talking to other people

examples.x: Whenever my friends are here, she just withdraws into her shell.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên nhút nhát hơn và tránh nói chuyện với người khác

senses.definition: the fact of having a place to live or stay, considered as a basic human need

examples.x: Human beings need food, clothing and shelter.
Thousands of people are without shelter following the wildfires.

senses.definition_vi: việc có một nơi để sống hoặc ở, được coi là một nhu cầu thiết yếu của con người

senses.definition: protection from rain, danger, or attack

examples.x: to take shelter from the storm
People were desperately seeking shelter from the gunfire.
The sand dunes provided shelter from the wind.
The fox was running for the shelter of the trees.

senses.definition_vi: sự bảo vệ khỏi mưa, nguy hiểm hoặc tấn công

senses.definition: a structure built to give protection, especially from the weather or from attack

examples.x: They built a rough shelter from old pieces of wood.
He helped construct temporary shelters in 10 villages before the rains came.
an air-raid shelter
a bomb shelter
Pupils have been sent home and schools have been turned into emergency shelters.
a shelter for cattle

senses.definition_vi: một cấu trúc được xây dựng để bảo vệ, đặc biệt là khỏi thời tiết hoặc khỏi bị tấn công

senses.definition: a building, usually owned by a charity, that provides a place to stay for people without a home, or protection for people or animals who have been badly treated

examples.x: a night shelter for homeless people
an animal shelter

senses.definition_vi: một tòa nhà, thường thuộc sở hữu của một tổ chức từ thiện, cung cấp nơi ở cho những người vô gia cư, hoặc bảo vệ cho những người hoặc động vật bị ngược đãi

senses.definition: to give somebody/something a place where they are protected from the weather or from danger; to protect somebody/something

examples.x: Trees shelter the house from the wind.
a wilderness region that shelters eagles and wolves
The American government has accused them of sheltering terrorists.
Perhaps I sheltered my daughter too much (= protected her too much from unpleasant or difficult experiences).

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp cho ai đó/cái gì đó một nơi trú ẩn khỏi thời tiết hoặc nguy hiểm; bảo vệ ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to stay in a place that protects you from the weather or from danger

examples.x: A bomb fell on the building, killing those who were sheltering inside.
We sheltered from the rain in a doorway.
Spectators sheltered under umbrellas as the rain got heavier.
As the storm approached, they tried to find somewhere to shelter.

senses.definition_vi: quả bóng nặng được sử dụng trong cuộc thi thể thao đẩy tạ

senses.definition: a photograph

examples.x: We stood there patiently while he snapped a few shots.
I got some good shots of people at the party.
I decided to stop and take a quick shot of the street.

senses.definition_vi: một bức ảnh chụp

senses.definition: a scene in a film that is filmed continuously by one camera

examples.x: the opening shot of a character walking across a desert
The director is clearly fond of tracking and aerial shots.
The exterior shots were filmed in Morocco and Malta.

senses.definition_vi: một cảnh trong phim được quay liên tục bởi một máy quay

senses.definition: a large number of small metal balls that you fire together from a shotgun

examples.x: Round shot whistled over our heads.
Conservationists have called on the government to ban the use of lead shot in shotgun cartridges.

senses.definition_vi: một số lượng lớn các viên bi kim loại nhỏ được bắn ra cùng lúc từ súng săn

senses.definition: a large stone or metal ball that was shot from a cannon or large gun in the past
senses.definition_vi: một viên đá hoặc kim loại lớn đã từng được bắn ra từ đại bác hoặc súng lớn trong quá khứ

senses.definition: a remark or an action that is usually one of a series, and is aimed against somebody/something that you are arguing or competing with

examples.x: This statement was the opening shot in the argument.
The supermarket fired the first shot in a price war today.
He couldn't resist taking a cheap shot at his political opponent.

senses.definition_vi: một lời nhận xét hoặc hành động thường là một trong một chuỗi, nhằm chống lại ai đó/điều gì đó mà bạn đang tranh cãi hoặc cạnh tranh với họ

senses.definition: the act of trying to do or achieve something

examples.x: The team are looking good for a shot at the title.
I've never produced a play before but I'll have a shot at it.
I'm willing to give it a shot.
Just give it your best shot (= try as hard as you can) and you'll be fine.

senses.definition_vi: hành động cố gắng làm hoặc đạt được điều gì đó

senses.definition: a small amount of a drug that is put into your body using a syringe

examples.x: a flu shot (= to protect you against flu)
a shot of morphine

senses.definition_vi: một lượng nhỏ thuốc được đưa vào cơ thể bằng ống tiêm

senses.definition: a small amount of a drink, especially a strong alcoholic one

examples.x: a shot of whisky

senses.definition_vi: một lượng nhỏ đồ uống, đặc biệt là đồ uống có cồn mạnh

senses.definition: the process of sending a spacecraft into and through space

examples.x: The space shot was shown live on television.
a moon shot

senses.definition_vi: quá trình gửi tàu vũ trụ vào và xuyên qua không gian

senses.definition: a horse, dog, etc. that has the particular chance of winning a race that is mentioned

examples.x: The horse is a 10–1 shot.

senses.definition_vi: một con ngựa, chó, v.v. có cơ hội thắng cuộc đua được đề cập

senses.definition: an important person
senses.definition_vi: một người quan trọng

senses.definition: to be the person who controls a situation
senses.definition_vi: là người kiểm soát một tình huống

senses.definition: very quickly and without hesitating

examples.x: If I had the chance to go there, I'd go like a shot.

senses.definition_vi: rất nhanh và không do dự

senses.definition: an attempt or a guess that is not likely to be successful but is worth trying

examples.x: It's a long shot, but it just might work.

senses.definition_vi: một nỗ lực hoặc một phỏng đoán không có khả năng thành công nhưng đáng để thử

senses.definition: not nearly; not at all

examples.x: It's not over yet—not by a long shot.

senses.definition_vi: không gần như; hoàn toàn không

senses.definition: a final remark, especially an unkind one, that somebody makes as they leave

examples.x: As her parting shot she warned Pete never to come near her again.

senses.definition_vi: một lời nhận xét cuối cùng, đặc biệt là một lời không hay, mà ai đó đưa ra khi họ rời đi

senses.definition: something that you say or do as a warning to somebody about what might happen if they do not change, etc.
senses.definition_vi: một điều bạn nói hoặc làm như một lời cảnh báo cho ai đó về những gì có thể xảy ra nếu họ không thay đổi, v.v.

senses.definition: something that encourages somebody/something or gives them the help they need

examples.x: Their enthusiasm has been a shot in the arm for all of us.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó khuyến khích ai đó/điều gì đó hoặc mang lại cho họ sự giúp đỡ cần thiết

senses.definition: a guess; something you do without knowing what the result will be

examples.x: The figure he came up with was really just a shot in the dark.
It was only a stab in the dark, but I hoped I might be right.

senses.definition_vi: một sự đoán; một điều bạn làm mà không biết kết quả sẽ ra sao

senses.definition: used to show what is right, appropriate, etc., especially when criticizing somebody’s actions

examples.x: You shouldn't drink and drive.
He should have been more careful.
A present for me? You shouldn't have! (= used to thank somebody politely)

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra điều gì là đúng, phù hợp, v.v., đặc biệt là khi chỉ trích hành động của ai đó

senses.definition: used for giving or asking for advice

examples.x: You should stop worrying about it.
Should I call him and apologize?
I should wait a little longer, if I were you.
‘She doesn't think she'll get a job.’ ‘She should worry, with all her qualifications (= she does not need to worry).’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đưa ra hoặc yêu cầu lời khuyên

senses.definition: used to say that you expect something is true or will happen

examples.x: We should arrive before dark.
I should have finished the book by Friday.
The roads should be less crowded today.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn mong đợi điều gì đó là đúng hoặc sẽ xảy ra

senses.definition: used to say that something that was expected has not happened

examples.x: It should be snowing now, according to the weather forecast.
The bus should have arrived ten minutes ago.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng một điều gì đó đã được mong đợi nhưng đã không xảy ra

senses.definition: used as the past form of shall when reporting what somebody has said

examples.x: He asked me what time he should come. (= His words were: ‘What time shall I come?’)
I said (that) I should be glad to help.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng làm dạng quá khứ của 'shall' khi báo cáo những gì ai đó đã nói

senses.definition: used after that when something is suggested or arranged

examples.x: She recommended that I should take some time off.
In order that training should be effective it must be planned systematically.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng sau 'that' khi một điều gì đó được đề xuất hoặc sắp xếp

senses.definition: used with I and we to give opinions that you are not certain about

examples.x: I should imagine it will take about three hours.
‘Is this enough food for everyone?’ ‘I should think so.’
‘Will it matter?’ ‘I shouldn't think so.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với 'I' và 'we' để đưa ra những ý kiến mà bạn không chắc chắn

senses.definition: used for expressing strong agreement

examples.x: ‘I know it's expensive but it will last for years.’ ‘I should hope so too!’
‘Nobody will oppose it.’ ‘I should think not!’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để bày tỏ sự đồng tình mạnh mẽ

senses.definition: used to refuse something or to show that you are annoyed at a request; used to express surprise about an event or a situation

examples.x: Why should I help him? He's never done anything for me.
How should I know where you've left your bag?
I got on the bus and who should be sitting in front of me but Tony!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để từ chối điều gì đó hoặc để thể hiện sự khó chịu trước một yêu cầu; được sử dụng để bày tỏ sự ngạc nhiên về một sự kiện hoặc tình huống

senses.definition: used to tell somebody that something would surprise them or make them laugh if they saw or experienced it

examples.x: You should have seen her face when she found out!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói với ai đó rằng điều gì đó sẽ làm họ ngạc nhiên hoặc khiến họ cười nếu họ nhìn thấy hoặc trải nghiệm nó

senses.definition: used after that after many adjectives that describe feelings

examples.x: I'm anxious that we should allow plenty of time.
I find it astonishing that he should be so rude to you.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng sau 'that' sau nhiều tính từ mô tả cảm xúc

senses.definition: used with I and we in polite requests

examples.x: I should like to call my lawyer.
We should be grateful for your help.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với 'I' và 'we' trong các yêu cầu lịch sự

senses.definition: used after I or we instead of would for describing what you would do if something else happened first

examples.x: If I were asked to work on Sundays, I should resign.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với 'I' hoặc 'we' thay vì 'would' để mô tả những gì bạn sẽ làm nếu một điều khác xảy ra trước

senses.definition: used to refer to a possible event or situation

examples.x: If you should change your mind, do let me know.
In case you should need any help, here's my number.
Should anyone call (= if anyone calls), please tell them I'm busy.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đề cập đến một sự kiện hoặc tình huống có thể xảy ra

senses.definition: either of the two parts of the body between the top of each arm and the neck

examples.x: your left/right shoulder
a tall man with broad shoulders
He slung the bag over his shoulder.
He looked back over his shoulder.
He carried the child on his shoulders.
I put a hand on her shoulder to stop her.
She tapped him on the shoulder.
He put an arm around her shoulders and pulled her close.
She shrugged her shoulders (= showing that she didn't know or care).
an off-the-shoulder dress (= that does not cover the shoulders)
a shoulder injury
I have to have shoulder surgery.

senses.definition_vi: một trong hai phần của cơ thể giữa đỉnh của mỗi cánh tay và cổ

senses.definition: having the type of shoulders mentioned

examples.x: broad-shouldered

senses.definition_vi: có loại vai được đề cập

senses.definition: the part of a piece of clothing that covers the shoulder

examples.x: a jacket with padded shoulders
There was snow on the shoulders of his heavy black coat.

senses.definition_vi: phần của một bộ quần áo che vai

senses.definition: meat from the top part of one of the front legs of an animal that has four legs
senses.definition_vi: thịt từ phần trên của một trong những chân trước của động vật bốn chân

senses.definition: a part of something, such as a bottle or mountain, that is like a shoulder in shape

examples.x: The village lay just around the shoulder of the hill.

senses.definition_vi: một phần của vật gì đó, như chai hoặc núi, có hình dạng giống vai

senses.definition: an area of ground at the side of a road where vehicles can stop in an emergency

examples.x: No shoulder for next 5 miles (= on a notice).

senses.definition_vi: một khu vực đất ở bên cạnh đường nơi các phương tiện có thể dừng lại trong trường hợp khẩn cấp

senses.definition: to be much better than other people or things

examples.x: His performance stood head and shoulders above the rest.

senses.definition_vi: tốt hơn nhiều so với những người hoặc vật khác

senses.definition: to be anxious and have the feeling that somebody is going to do something unpleasant or harmful to you
senses.definition_vi: lo lắng và có cảm giác rằng ai đó sắp làm điều gì đó khó chịu hoặc có hại cho bạn

senses.definition: to treat somebody in a way that is not friendly
senses.definition_vi: đối xử với ai đó theo cách không thân thiện

senses.definition: to be sensitive about something that happened in the past and become easily offended if it is mentioned because you think that you were treated unfairly

examples.x: He has a real chip on his shoulder about not being chosen for the team.

senses.definition_vi: nhạy cảm về điều gì đó đã xảy ra trong quá khứ và dễ bị xúc phạm nếu nó được đề cập vì bạn nghĩ rằng bạn đã bị đối xử không công bằng

senses.definition: to be a sensible person
senses.definition_vi: là một người chín chắn

senses.definition: used to describe a young person who acts in a more sensible way than you would expect for a person of their age
senses.definition_vi: dùng để mô tả một người trẻ tuổi có hành vi chín chắn hơn mong đợi đối với lứa tuổi của họ

senses.definition: if blame, guilt, etc. is on somebody’s shoulders, they must take responsibility for it

examples.x: Stop trying to put the blame on somebody else’s shoulders.

senses.definition_vi: nếu sự đổ lỗi, tội lỗi, v.v. đặt lên vai ai đó, họ phải chịu trách nhiệm về nó

senses.definition: to start working very hard at a particular task

examples.x: Everyone is going to have to put their shoulder to the wheel.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu làm việc rất chăm chỉ vào một nhiệm vụ cụ thể

senses.definition: to meet and spend time with a famous person, socially or as part of your job

examples.x: He’s rubbing shoulders with stars all the time.
She had been rubbing elbows with celebrities.

senses.definition_vi: gặp gỡ và dành thời gian với một người nổi tiếng, về mặt xã hội hoặc như một phần công việc của bạn

senses.definition: used to describe a person who listens to your problems and gives you sympathy

examples.x: He was a fatherly shoulder to cry on when things went wrong.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để mô tả một người lắng nghe những vấn đề của bạn và đưa ra sự thông cảm

senses.definition: physically close to somebody

examples.x: The large crowd stood shoulder to shoulder in the stands.
The route of the procession was lined with police officers standing shoulder to shoulder.

senses.definition_vi: về mặt vật lý gần gũi với ai đó

senses.definition: as one group that has the same aims, opinions, etc.
senses.definition_vi: như một nhóm có cùng mục tiêu, ý kiến, v.v.

senses.definition: if you say something straight from the shoulder, you are being very honest and direct, even if what you are saying is critical
senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói điều gì đó thẳng thắn, bạn đang rất trung thực và thẳng thắn, ngay cả khi những gì bạn đang nói là chỉ trích

senses.definition: a loud cry of anger, fear, excitement, etc.

examples.x: angry shouts
I heard her warning shout too late.
a shout of anger/encouragement
Thunderous applause and shouts of 'bravo' greeted his performance.
Charlie gave a shout of joy and even his brothers looked pleased.
He ignored the loud shouts from the crowd outside.
A shout from downstairs broke the silence.

senses.definition_vi: một tiếng kêu lớn vì giận dữ, sợ hãi, phấn khích, v.v.

senses.definition: a person’s turn to buy drinks

examples.x: What are you drinking? It's my shout.

senses.definition_vi: lượt của một người để mời đồ uống

senses.definition: to have a good chance of winning something or of achieving something
senses.definition_vi: có cơ hội tốt để giành chiến thắng một cái gì đó hoặc đạt được một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to tell somebody something

examples.x: Give me a shout when you're ready.
Give me a shout if you'd like to come with us.

senses.definition_vi: cho ai đó biết điều gì đó

senses.definition: to say something in a loud voice; to speak loudly/angrily to somebody

examples.x: Stop shouting and listen!
I shouted for help but nobody came.
Then he started shouting and swearing at her.
There are few things that get me shouting at the television.
We cannot learn until we stop shouting at each other.

examples.cf: shout at somebody to do something
examples.x: She shouted at him to shut the gate.
Protesters shouted slogans denouncing the war.
to shout abuse/encouragement/orders
A drunk man was shouting obscenities at the police officer.
The coach shouts instructions to players on the pitch.
He shouted that he couldn't swim.
She shouted herself hoarse, cheering on the team.
‘Run!’ he shouted.

senses.definition_vi: nói điều gì đó bằng giọng lớn; nói to/giận dữ với ai đó

senses.definition: to make a loud noise

examples.x: She could hear him shouting and screaming in the next room.
I wanted to shout for joy.
He was hugging them and shouting with glee.
She shouted out in pain when she tried to move her leg.

senses.definition_vi: tạo ra một tiếng động lớn

senses.definition: to buy drinks or food for somebody in a bar, restaurant, etc.

examples.x: I'll shout—what are you drinking?
Who's going to shout me a drink?

senses.definition_vi: mua đồ uống hoặc thức ăn cho ai đó tại quán bar, nhà hàng, v.v.

senses.definition: to talk about something in a very public way

examples.x: He was in love and wanted to shout it from the rooftops.

senses.definition_vi: nói về điều gì đó một cách rất công khai

senses.definition: a programme on television or the radio

examples.x: Millions of people watch the show.
She hosts the morning show.
a TV/television/radio show
a quiz show
a reality show (= one that is based on real people, not actors)

senses.definition_vi: một chương trình trên truyền hình hoặc radio

senses.definition: a theatre performance, especially one that includes singing and dancing

examples.x: to go to/see a show
to put on/stage a show
The book has been turned into a stage show.
They will perform in a live show on Saturday night.
a one-man/one-woman show
She's the star of the show!

senses.definition_vi: một buổi biểu diễn sân khấu, đặc biệt là buổi biểu diễn có ca hát và nhảy múa

senses.definition: a concert, especially of rock music

examples.x: My first full-scale rock show was Fleetwood Mac, Madison Square Garden, back in 1977.

senses.definition_vi: một buổi hòa nhạc, đặc biệt là nhạc rock

senses.definition: an occasion when a collection of things are brought together for people to look at

examples.x: a dog/car/gun show
This is one of the biggest agricultural shows in Wales.
The artist is holding her first solo show.
The paintings are on show until April.

senses.definition_vi: một dịp mà một bộ sưu tập các vật phẩm được tập hợp lại để mọi người xem

senses.definition: an action or a way of behaving that shows how you feel

examples.x: a show of emotion/support
a show of force/strength by the army
The Democrats organized a show of strength, a mass rally in Central Park.
A show of force by 4 000 soldiers led to an agreement being reached quickly.
He was completely unmoved by her little show of temper.
She made a great show of wanting to leave, but I knew she didn't mean it.
She was afraid that too demonstrative a show of gratitude might be misinterpreted.
The company is seeking to rally a big show of support for the project.

senses.definition_vi: một hành động hoặc cách cư xử thể hiện cảm xúc của bạn

senses.definition: something that is done only to give a good impression, but is not sincere

examples.x: He may seem charming, but it's all show!
She pretends to be interested in opera, but it's only for show.
He made a great show of affection, but I knew he didn't mean it.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó chỉ được thực hiện để tạo ấn tượng tốt, nhưng không chân thành

senses.definition: a brightly coloured or pleasant sight

examples.x: a lovely show of spring flowers

senses.definition_vi: một cảnh tượng đầy màu sắc hoặc dễ chịu

senses.definition: an event, a business or a situation where something is being done or organized

examples.x: She runs the whole show.
I won't interfere—it's your show.

senses.definition_vi: một sự kiện, một doanh nghiệp hoặc một tình huống nơi một cái gì đó đang được thực hiện hoặc tổ chức

senses.definition: something that is done in a particular way

examples.x: The team put on a good show in the competition.
It's a poor show if he forgets your birthday.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó được thực hiện theo một cách cụ thể

senses.definition: an event that is planned only in order to impress people so that they will support or buy something

examples.x: the dog and pony show of his visits to the war zone
a dog and pony show to sell the idea to investors

senses.definition_vi: một sự kiện được lên kế hoạch chỉ để gây ấn tượng với mọi người để họ ủng hộ hoặc mua một cái gì đó

senses.definition: intended to be seen but not used

examples.x: These items are just for show—they're not for sale.

senses.definition_vi: dành để xem nhưng không để sử dụng

senses.definition: to start an activity or a journey

examples.x: Let's get this show on the road!

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu một hoạt động hoặc một hành trình

senses.definition: used to show you like something or to say that somebody has done something well
senses.definition_vi: dùng để thể hiện bạn thích điều gì đó hoặc để nói rằng ai đó đã làm tốt điều gì đó

senses.definition: a way of voting for or against something in which people raise their hands to vote

examples.x: The vote was passed by a show of hands.
Let’s have a show of hands. Who’s in favour of the proposal?

senses.definition_vi: một cách bỏ phiếu ủng hộ hoặc phản đối điều gì đó bằng cách giơ tay để bỏ phiếu

senses.definition: to attract more attention and praise than other people in a particular situation

examples.x: As always, the children stole the show.
British bands stole the show at this year’s awards.

senses.definition_vi: thu hút nhiều sự chú ý và khen ngợi hơn những người khác trong một tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: to make something clear; to prove something

examples.x: The figures clearly show that her claims are false.
The government's popularity is declining, as the polls show.
Our research showed us that women were more interested in their health than men.
The report showed an increase in sales.
Studies show a link between cancer and processed meats.
His new book shows him to be a first-rate storyteller.
Tax records show Shakespeare living near the Globe Theatre in 1599.
This shows how people are influenced by TV advertisements.
History has shown us how dangerous nationalism can be.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho cái gì đó rõ ràng; chứng minh cái gì đó

senses.definition: to let somebody see something

examples.x: You have to show your ticket as you go in.
If there's a letter from France please show it to me.
Have you shown your work to anyone?
Have you shown anyone your work?
We were shown a training video.

senses.definition_vi: cho ai đó xem cái gì đó
