Write on one side of the paper only.
Fry the steaks for two minutes on each side.

senses.definition_vi: một trong hai bề mặt của vật gì đó phẳng và mỏng, chẳng hạn như giấy hoặc vải.

senses.definition: the amount of writing needed to fill one side of a sheet of paper

examples.x: He told us not to write more than three sides.

senses.definition_vi: lượng chữ viết cần thiết để lấp đầy một mặt của một tờ giấy.

senses.definition: any of the flat surfaces of a solid object

examples.x: A cube has six sides.
Each side of the pyramid is greater than five acres in area.

senses.definition_vi: bất kỳ bề mặt phẳng nào của một vật thể rắn.

senses.definition: any of the lines that form a flat shape such as a square or triangle

examples.x: a shape with five sides
The farm buildings form three sides of a square.

senses.definition_vi: bất kỳ đường nào tạo thành một hình phẳng như hình vuông hoặc hình tam giác.

senses.definition: used in adjectives to state the number or type of sides

examples.x: a six-sided object
a glass-sided container

senses.definition_vi: dùng trong các tính từ để chỉ số lượng hoặc loại cạnh.

senses.definition: a place or position very near to somebody/something

examples.x: Her husband stood at her side.
She was glad to have him by her side.
Keep close to my side.
Her friends never seem to leave her side.
He rushed to be at her side.

senses.definition_vi: một địa điểm hoặc vị trí rất gần ai đó/cái gì đó.

senses.definition: one of the two or more people or groups taking part in an argument, war, etc.

examples.x: Both sides agreed to restore diplomatic relations.
At some point during the war he seems to have changed sides.
Each side is capable of destroying the other in a nuclear war.
We have finally reached an agreement acceptable to all sides.
The two sides announced a deal yesterday.
to be on the winning/losing side
There are faults on both sides.
There is anger on both sides of the political divide.

senses.definition_vi: một trong hai hoặc nhiều người hoặc nhóm tham gia vào một cuộc tranh cãi, chiến tranh, v.v.

senses.definition: one of the opinions, attitudes, or positions held by somebody in an argument, a business arrangement, etc.

examples.x: We heard both sides of the argument.
I just want you to hear my side of the story first.
One side of the debate is articulated best by France and Germany.
The defendant has had no opportunity to put his side of the case.
Will you keep your side of the bargain?
On the plus side, the film is beautifully shot and edited.

senses.definition_vi: một trong những ý kiến, thái độ hoặc lập trường của ai đó trong một cuộc tranh luận, thỏa thuận kinh doanh, v.v.

senses.definition: a particular aspect of something, especially a situation or a person’s character

examples.x: These poems reveal her gentle side.
It's interesting to see another side of a story that is so well known.
It's good you can see the funny side of the situation.
I'll take care of that side of things.
This is a side of Alan that I never knew existed.
the darker side of human nature
a behind-the-scenes documentary which promises to show a side of him rarely seen in public

senses.definition_vi: một khía cạnh cụ thể của một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là một tình huống hoặc tính cách của một người.

senses.definition: a feeling that you are better than other people

examples.x: There was no side to him at all.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác rằng bạn tốt hơn những người khác.

senses.definition: a sports team

examples.x: As captain, Pryce is confident of leading his side to victory.
The French have a very strong side.
We were on the winning/losing side.
As the home side, they were expected to play an attacking game.

senses.definition_vi: một đội thể thao.

senses.definition: the part of your family that people belong to who are related either to your mother or to your father

examples.x: a cousin on my father’s side (= a child of my father’s brother or sister)

senses.definition_vi: phần gia đình mà mọi người thuộc về, có quan hệ với mẹ hoặc cha của bạn.

senses.definition: a side dish (= a small amount of food, for example a salad, served with the main course of a meal)

examples.x: Your dinner comes with a choice of two sides.

senses.definition_vi: một món ăn kèm (= một lượng nhỏ thức ăn, ví dụ như salad, được phục vụ cùng với món chính của bữa ăn).

senses.definition: one of the two halves of an animal that has been killed for meat
senses.definition_vi: một trong hai nửa của một con vật đã bị giết để lấy thịt.

senses.definition: a television channel

examples.x: What's on the other side?

senses.definition_vi: một kênh truyền hình.

senses.definition: to support and agree with somebody

examples.x: I'm definitely on your side in this.
Whose side are you on anyway?

senses.definition_vi: ủng hộ và đồng ý với ai đó.

senses.definition: the boyfriend or girlfriend of somebody who is already married or in a steady sexual relationship with somebody else

examples.x: Is he your bit on the side?

senses.definition_vi: bạn trai hoặc bạn gái của người đã có vợ/chồng hoặc đang có mối quan hệ tình dục ổn định với người khác.

senses.definition: to choose between two possible choices
senses.definition_vi: chọn giữa hai lựa chọn khả thi.

senses.definition: to show too much of a good quality in order to avoid showing too little

examples.x: I thought it was better to err on the side of caution (= to be too careful rather than take a risk).

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện quá nhiều một phẩm chất tốt để tránh thể hiện quá ít.

senses.definition: moving to the left and then to the right and then back again

examples.x: He shook his head slowly from side to side.
The ship rolled from side to side.
The cat sat with its tail twitching from side to side.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển sang trái rồi sang phải rồi lại quay lại.

senses.definition: from or living in a poor area or part of town
senses.definition_vi: từ hoặc sống ở một khu vực hoặc một phần của thị trấn nghèo.

senses.definition: to make somebody pleased with you/annoyed with you
senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó hài lòng với bạn/khó chịu với bạn.

senses.definition: to be in a bad mood for the whole day for no particular reason
senses.definition_vi: ở trong tâm trạng tồi tệ cả ngày mà không có lý do cụ thể.

senses.definition: said about people who never seem happy with what they have and always think they could be happier in a different place or situation
senses.definition_vi: nói về những người không bao giờ có vẻ hài lòng với những gì họ có và luôn nghĩ rằng họ có thể hạnh phúc hơn ở một nơi hoặc tình huống khác.

senses.definition: to have something as an advantage that will make it more likely that you will achieve something

examples.x: She may not win this year, but she does have youth on her side.

senses.definition_vi: có một lợi thế sẽ làm tăng khả năng bạn đạt được điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to know where you can get an advantage for yourself
senses.definition_vi: biết nơi bạn có thể có lợi cho bản thân.

senses.definition: to be forced to change from feeling pleased or satisfied to feeling disappointed or annoyed

examples.x: He’ll be laughing on the other side of his face when he reads my letter.

senses.definition_vi: bị buộc phải thay đổi từ cảm giác hài lòng hoặc mãn nguyện sang cảm giác thất vọng hoặc khó chịu.

senses.definition: to fail to give your friends, family, etc. the help and support they expect, or to behave in a way that makes them disappointed

examples.x: You can always rely on Maggie—she’d never let the side down.
I felt I was letting the side down by not going to the wedding.

senses.definition_vi: không giúp đỡ bạn bè, gia đình, v.v. như họ mong đợi, hoặc cư xử theo cách khiến họ thất vọng.

senses.definition: to be cheerful or positive about a bad situation, for example by thinking only of the advantages and not the disadvantages

examples.x: Look on the bright side. You managed to do more than I did.

senses.definition_vi: lạc quan hoặc tích cực về một tình huống tồi tệ, ví dụ bằng cách chỉ nghĩ về những ưu điểm và không nghĩ về những nhược điểm.

senses.definition: to stay with somebody, especially in order to take care of them
senses.definition_vi: ở lại với ai đó, đặc biệt là để chăm sóc họ.

senses.definition: in or from all directions; everywhere

examples.x: We realized we were surrounded on all sides.
Disaster threatens on every side.
She was bombarded with questions from all sides.

senses.definition_vi: từ hoặc ở mọi hướng; khắp mọi nơi.

senses.definition: slightly too big, small, high, etc.

examples.x: These shoes are a little on the tight side.
Don’t you think you’re a bit on the short side to play basketball?

senses.definition_vi: hơi quá lớn, nhỏ, cao, v.v.

senses.definition: used to introduce the good points about somebody/something, especially after the bad points have been mentioned

examples.x: On the credit side, she’s always willing to work very late.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để giới thiệu những điểm tốt về ai đó/cái gì đó, đặc biệt là sau khi đã đề cập đến những điểm xấu.

senses.definition: on the woman’s side of the family
senses.definition_vi: về phía gia đình người phụ nữ.

senses.definition: out of your way

examples.x: I left my bags on one side.

senses.definition_vi: ngoài đường đi của bạn.

senses.definition: to be dealt with later

examples.x: I put his complaint to one side until I had more time.
Leaving that to one side for a moment, are there any other questions?

senses.definition_vi: sẽ được giải quyết sau.

senses.definition: younger or older than 40, 50, etc. years of age
senses.definition_vi: trẻ hơn hoặc già hơn 40, 50, v.v. tuổi.

senses.definition: being especially careful; taking no risks

examples.x: I took some extra cash just to be on the safe side.

senses.definition_vi: đặc biệt cẩn thận; không mạo hiểm.

senses.definition: in addition to your main job

examples.x: a mechanic who buys and sells cars on the side

senses.definition_vi: ngoài công việc chính của bạn.

senses.definition: secretly or illegally

examples.x: He's married but he has a girlfriend on the side.

senses.definition_vi: một cách bí mật hoặc bất hợp pháp

senses.definition: served at the same time as the main part of the meal, but on a separate plate
senses.definition_vi: được phục vụ cùng lúc với phần chính của bữa ăn, nhưng trên một đĩa riêng

senses.definition: in trouble with the police
senses.definition_vi: gặp rắc rối với cảnh sát

senses.definition: the aspect of a situation that is the opposite of or contrasts with the one you have been talking about
senses.definition_vi: khía cạnh của một tình huống đối lập hoặc tương phản với khía cạnh bạn vừa nói đến

senses.definition: with the top part turned to the top; in the correct, normal position

examples.x: I dropped my toast, but luckily it fell right side up.

senses.definition_vi: với phần trên hướng lên trên; ở vị trí đúng, bình thường

senses.definition: close together and facing in the same direction

examples.x: There were two children ahead, walking side by side.
The two sat side by side on the bench.

senses.definition_vi: gần nhau và hướng về cùng một phía

senses.definition: together, without any difficulties

examples.x: We have been using both systems, side by side, for two years.
The two communities exist happily side by side.

senses.definition_vi: cùng nhau, không có khó khăn gì

senses.definition: used to refer to either of two opposite opinions on an issue

examples.x: The two countries are often on opposite sides of the fence when it comes to climate change.
There are arguments on both sides of the aisle.

senses.definition_vi: để chỉ một trong hai ý kiến đối lập về một vấn đề

senses.definition: to laugh a lot at somebody/something
senses.definition_vi: cười rất nhiều vì ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to express support for somebody in an argument

examples.x: She didn't think it was wise to take sides in their argument.

senses.definition_vi: bày tỏ sự ủng hộ đối với ai đó trong một cuộc tranh cãi

senses.definition: to speak to somebody in private, especially in order to warn or tell them about something
senses.definition_vi: nói chuyện riêng với ai đó, đặc biệt là để cảnh báo hoặc cho họ biết về điều gì đó

senses.definition: before a particular time, event, age, etc.

examples.x: They aren't likely to arrive this side of midnight.

senses.definition_vi: trước một thời gian, sự kiện, độ tuổi, v.v. cụ thể

senses.definition: a person or thing that repeatedly annoys somebody or stops them from doing something
senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật liên tục làm phiền ai đó hoặc ngăn cản họ làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to say that somebody can wait for something to happen or can wait before doing something
senses.definition_vi: để nói rằng ai đó có thể chờ đợi điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc chờ đợi trước khi làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to talk about two ways of looking at the same situation
senses.definition_vi: để nói về hai cách nhìn nhận cùng một tình huống

senses.definition: an act or the sound of sighing

examples.x: to give/heave/let out a sigh
a deep sigh
‘I'll wait,’ he said with a sigh.
We all breathed a sigh of relief when it was over.

senses.definition_vi: một hành động hoặc âm thanh của việc thở dài

senses.definition: to take and then let out a long deep breath that can be heard, to show that you are disappointed, sad, tired, etc.

examples.x: He sighed deeply at the thought.
She sighed with relief that it was all over.

senses.definition_vi: hít một hơi thật sâu rồi thở ra, có thể nghe thấy, để thể hiện sự thất vọng, buồn bã, mệt mỏi, v.v.

senses.definition: to say something with a sigh

examples.x: ‘Oh well, better luck next time,’ she sighed.

senses.definition_vi: nói điều gì đó với một tiếng thở dài

senses.definition: to make a long sound like a sigh

examples.x: the sighing of the wind through the trees
branches sighing in the wind

senses.definition_vi: tạo ra một âm thanh dài giống như tiếng thở dài

senses.definition: the ability to see

examples.x: to lose your sight (= to become blind)
She has very good sight.
The disease has affected her sight.
He has very little sight in his right eye.
It's important that you have regular sight tests.

senses.definition_vi: khả năng nhìn

senses.definition: the act of seeing somebody/something

examples.x: She kept sight of him in her mirror.
She caught sight of a car in the distance.
After ten days at sea, we had our first sight of land.
The mere sight of him makes me want to scream.
The sight of him hobbling off so early in the match depressed everyone.
He laughed quietly to himself at the sight.
I have been known to faint at the sight of blood.
The soldiers were given orders to shoot on sight (= as soon as they saw somebody).

senses.definition_vi: hành động nhìn thấy ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: the area or distance within which somebody can see or something can be seen

examples.x: There was no one in sight.
They stole everything in sight.
The end is in sight (= will happen soon).
The goats ate everything in sight.
At last we came in sight of a few houses.
A bicycle came into sight on the main road.
They marched on and by the following afternoon the enemy was within sight.
He sprinted ahead as they came within sight of the finishing line.
Leave any valuables in your car out of sight.
Keep out of sight (= stay where you cannot be seen).
She never lets her daughter out of her sight (= always keeps her where she can see her).
Get out of my sight! (= Go away!)
The boat disappeared from sight.
The house was hidden from sight behind some trees.
He won't let the children leave his sight.
Her father was nowhere in sight.
The cricket ground was situated within sight of both village pubs.
They waited until the enemy was in plain sight.
He strode by, in full sight of the guards.
He didn't shoot until he had a clear sight of the goal.

senses.definition_vi: khu vực hoặc khoảng cách mà trong đó ai đó có thể nhìn thấy hoặc điều gì đó có thể được nhìn thấy

senses.definition: a thing that you see or can see

examples.x: Roadside stalls are a common sight in the city.
It's a spectacular sight as the flamingos lift into the air.
The museum attempts to recreate the sights and sounds of wartime Britain.
He was a sorry sight, soaked to the skin and shivering.
The bird is now a rare sight in this country.
He became a familiar sight on the streets of Oxford.
The gardens were a beautiful sight to behold in the twilight.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ mà bạn nhìn thấy hoặc có thể nhìn thấy

senses.definition: the interesting places, especially in a town or city, that are often visited by tourists

examples.x: We're going to Paris for the weekend to see the sights.
The next day I did the sights of the city.
It's best if you can get someone local to show you the sights.

senses.definition_vi: những địa điểm thú vị, đặc biệt là ở một thị trấn hoặc thành phố, thường được khách du lịch ghé thăm

senses.definition: a person or thing that looks silly, untidy, unpleasant, etc.

examples.x: She looks a sight in that hat!

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật trông ngớ ngẩn, lôi thôi, khó chịu, v.v.

senses.definition: a device that you look through to aim a gun, etc. or to look at something through a telescope, etc.

examples.x: He had the deer in his sights now.
to align the sights on the target
Even as a young actress, she always had Hollywood firmly in her sights (= as her final goal).

senses.definition_vi: một thiết bị mà bạn nhìn qua để ngắm bắn súng, v.v. hoặc để nhìn thứ gì đó qua kính thiên văn, v.v.

senses.definition: when you first begin to consider something

examples.x: At first sight, it may look like a generous offer, but always read the small print.

senses.definition_vi: khi bạn bắt đầu xem xét điều gì đó

senses.definition: when you see somebody/something for the first time

examples.x: It was love at first sight (= we fell in love the first time we saw each other).
We fell in love with the house at first sight.
He looked at first sight like a tourist.

senses.definition_vi: khi bạn nhìn thấy ai đó/điều gì đó lần đầu tiên

senses.definition: to hate, etc. somebody/something very much

examples.x: I can't stand the sight of him!
We've shared an office for too long and we're sick of the sight of each other.

senses.definition_vi: ghét, v.v. ai đó/điều gì đó rất nhiều

senses.definition: to appear, especially when moving gradually closer from a long way off

examples.x: A ship hove into sight.
Like a galleon in full sail, Cara hove into view.

senses.definition_vi: xuất hiện, đặc biệt là khi di chuyển dần lại gần từ một khoảng cách xa

senses.definition: in somebody’s opinion

examples.x: We are all equal in the sight of God.

senses.definition_vi: theo ý kiến của ai đó

senses.definition: to recognize somebody without knowing them well
senses.definition_vi: nhận ra ai đó mà không cần biết rõ họ

senses.definition: to become no longer able to see somebody/something

examples.x: They finally lost sight of land.

senses.definition_vi: không còn có thể nhìn thấy ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to stop considering something; to forget something

examples.x: We must not lose sight of our original aim.

senses.definition_vi: ngừng xem xét điều gì đó; quên điều gì đó

senses.definition: not pleasant to look at

examples.x: You should have seen him in his swimming trunks—not a pretty sight!

senses.definition_vi: không dễ chịu khi nhìn

senses.definition: impossible for anyone to find or see

examples.x: I wanted to talk to him but he was nowhere to be found.
The children were nowhere to be seen.
A peace settlement is nowhere in sight (= is not likely in the near future).

senses.definition_vi: không thể tìm thấy hoặc nhìn thấy bởi bất kỳ ai

senses.definition: used to say somebody will quickly be forgotten when they are no longer with you
senses.definition_vi: để nói rằng ai đó sẽ nhanh chóng bị quên khi họ không còn ở bên bạn

senses.definition: to expect more/less from a situation

examples.x: If they can’t afford such a big house, they’ll just have to lower their sights a little.
After failing to get into university, he lowered his sights and got a job in a shop.

senses.definition_vi: để mong đợi nhiều hơn/ít hơn từ một tình huống

senses.definition: to decide that you want something and to try very hard to get it

examples.x: She's set her sights on getting into Harvard.
I had set my sights on a career in journalism.
He says he wants to win the trophy, but I think he's setting his sights too high.
She has her sights set on becoming a writer.

senses.definition_vi: quyết định rằng bạn muốn điều gì đó và cố gắng hết sức để có được nó

senses.definition: very much better; much too good, etc.

examples.x: She's done a darn sight better than I have.
It's worth a damn sight more than I thought.

senses.definition_vi: tốt hơn rất nhiều; tốt hơn nhiều, v.v.

senses.definition: a person or thing that you are pleased to see; something that is very pleasant to look at
senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật mà bạn hài lòng khi nhìn thấy; một thứ rất dễ chịu để nhìn vào

senses.definition: if you buy something sight unseen, you do not have an opportunity to see it before you buy it

examples.x: I bought it, sight unseen.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn mua thứ gì đó mà chưa xem, bạn không có cơ hội nhìn thấy nó trước khi mua

senses.definition: an event, an action, a fact, etc. that shows that something exists, is happening or may happen in the future

examples.x: Looking back, I should have seen the signs.
a clear/visible sign
an encouraging sign
a positive sign
The fact that he didn't say ‘no’ immediately is a good sign.
If I had noticed the warning signs, none of this would have happened.
Early signs point to business improving.
This move will be seen as a sign of weakness.
Bankers say they can definitely detect signs of a recovery.
Headaches may be a sign of stress.
There is no sign of John anywhere.
Soldiers swarmed the city looking for any sign of her.
There was no sign of life in the house (= there seemed to be nobody there).
Her work is showing some signs of improvement.
I hope this incident isn't a sign of things to come.
Get this test if you have signs and symptoms of diabetes.
He is reading the signs all wrong.
Call the police at the first sign of trouble.
The gloomy weather shows no sign of improving.
There is little sign of this happening in the immediate future.
If an interview is too easy, it's a sure sign that you haven't got the job.
There were no outward signs that anything was wrong.

examples.x: We have very similar interests.
The experiment was repeated, with similar results.
I came across a similar situation last year.
The brothers look very similar.
The three portraits are remarkably similar.
My teaching style is similar to that of most other teachers.
The case is strikingly similar to another case from the 1990s.
The two houses are similar in size.
All the narratives follow a similar pattern.
The disease attacks the immune system in a similar way to AIDS.
She easily won today, and hopes to carry on in a similar vein tomorrow.
Stir the paint with a piece of wood or something similar.

senses.definition_vi: giống ai đó/điều gì đó nhưng không hoàn toàn giống

senses.definition: the state of being similar to somebody/something but not exactly the same

examples.x: The report highlights the similarity between the two groups.
She bears a striking similarity to her mother.
There is some similarity in the way they sing.
In this work we can observe the stylistic similarity with Beethoven.
The results also showed the similarity of the two groups.
They are both doctors but that is where the similarity ends.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái giống ai đó/điều gì đó nhưng không hoàn toàn giống

senses.definition: a feature that things or people have that makes them like each other

examples.x: a study of the similarities and differences between the two countries
similarities in/of style
The karate bout has many similarities to a boxing match.

senses.definition_vi: một đặc điểm mà các sự vật hoặc con người có làm cho họ giống nhau

senses.definition: in almost the same way

examples.x: It is a little cheaper than other similarly sized cars.
He has a similarly impressive record in the sport.
Husband and wife were similarly successful in their chosen careers.
The different groups of women in the study responded similarly.
All sections of society were similarly affected by the war.
Phosphorus behaves similarly to nitrogen.

senses.definition_vi: theo cách gần như giống nhau

senses.definition: used to say that two facts, actions, statements, etc. are like each other

examples.x: The United States won most of the track and field events. Similarly, in swimming, the top three places went to Americans.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng hai sự kiện, hành động, tuyên bố, v.v. giống nhau

senses.definition: not complicated; easy to understand or do

examples.x: a simple solution/explanation/question/task/example
You will soon see that what once seemed impossible is now simple for you.
This machine is very simple to use.

examples.cf: something is simple for somebody to do
examples.x: The game is supposed to be simple for anyone to play.

examples.cf: it is simple to do something
examples.x: It's too simple to blame the lack of manufacturing jobs on the last government.
Give the necessary information but keep it simple.

examples.cf: it is simple for somebody to do something
examples.x: It would be much simpler for me to go there myself and sort things out.
We lost because we played badly. It's as simple as that.
If you enjoy your workout, you'll want to do it. It's that simple.
It all sounds simple enough.
Let me make it simple —this is going to take years to do.
These are bad guys, plain and simple.
The answer is really quite simple.
There must be a simpler way of doing this.
In simple terms, the more saturated fat something contains, the less healthy it is.
a relatively simple process

senses.definition_vi: không phức tạp; dễ hiểu hoặc dễ thực hiện

senses.definition: basic or plain without anything extra or unnecessary

examples.x: simple but elegant clothes
We had a simple meal of soup and bread.
The accommodation is simple but spacious.
The simple things in life are often the best.
He was pleased to live the simple life and enjoy nature around him.
simple pleasures, like reading and walking
The engine design is elegantly simple.
contemporary furniture that is simple in design

senses.definition_vi: cơ bản hoặc đơn giản không có gì thêm hoặc không cần thiết

senses.definition: used before a noun to emphasize that it is exactly that and nothing else

examples.x: We cannot ignore the simple fact that the country cannot sustain the current level of economic growth.
The simple truth is that we just can't afford it.
It's a simple matter of giving them enough to eat.
It was a matter of simple survival.
It's nothing to worry about—just a simple headache.
I had to do it for the simple reason that (= because) I couldn't trust anyone else.
A simple majority is all that is required.
The simple act of eating raises your metabolism.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trước một danh từ để nhấn mạnh rằng đó chính xác là điều đó và không có gì khác

senses.definition: consisting of only a few parts; not complicated in structure

examples.x: simple forms of life, for example amoebas
a simple machine
a simple sentence (= one with only one verb)
a simple model of a business market

senses.definition_vi: bao gồm chỉ một vài bộ phận; không phức tạp về cấu trúc

senses.definition: ordinary; not special

examples.x: I'm a simple country girl.
The poem describes simple young soldiers in the Civil War.

senses.definition_vi: tầm thường; không đặc biệt

senses.definition: slow to learn; having a learning disability
senses.definition_vi: chậm học hỏi; có khó khăn trong học tập

senses.definition: used to describe the present or past tense of a verb that is formed without using an auxiliary verb, as in She loves him (= the simple present tense) or He arrived late (= the simple past tense)
senses.definition_vi: được dùng để mô tả thì hiện tại hoặc quá khứ của động từ được hình thành mà không sử dụng động từ phụ trợ, như trong 'She loves him' (thì hiện tại đơn) hoặc 'He arrived late' (thì quá khứ đơn)

senses.definition: used after the noun that it refers to in order to emphasize that there is nothing but the thing you have just mentioned involved in something

examples.x: It's laziness, pure and simple.
The man wants revenge, pure and simple.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng sau danh từ mà nó đề cập để nhấn mạnh rằng không có gì khác ngoài điều bạn vừa đề cập liên quan đến điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to emphasize how easy or basic something is

examples.x: To order, simply click here.
This is not to suggest we simply ignore the problem.
She says that the company was simply trying to protect its business.
Simply add hot water and stir.
The runway is simply a strip of grass.
Fame is often simply a matter of being in the right place at the right time.
You can enjoy all the water sports, or simply lie on the beach.
We are simply saying research is good.
Most internet users simply want information.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh điều gì đó dễ dàng hoặc cơ bản như thế nào

senses.definition: in a way that is easy to understand

examples.x: The book explains grammar simply and clearly.
Anyway, to put it simply, we still owe them £2 000.
Simply put, electronic music is anything made using technology.
Put simply, cells contain an inbuilt mechanism which determines their lifespan.
Simply stated, the time for major reform is now.
It is in many ways a simple story, simply told.

senses.definition_vi: theo cách dễ hiểu

senses.definition: in a way that is natural and plain

examples.x: The rooms are simply furnished.
They live simply (= they do not spend much money).

senses.definition_vi: theo cách tự nhiên và giản dị

senses.definition: used to emphasize a statement

examples.x: You simply must see the play.
You simply have to come with us.
He simply refused to believe it.
The view is simply wonderful!
That is simply not true!
This information is simply wrong.
Her behaviour is simply unacceptable.
I haven't seen her for simply ages.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh một lời khẳng định

senses.definition: used to introduce a summary or an explanation of something that you have just said or done

examples.x: I don't want to be rude, it's simply that we have to be careful who we give this information to.
He was loud, vulgar and arrogant—quite simply the rudest man I've ever met!

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để giới thiệu một tóm tắt hoặc một lời giải thích về điều gì đó bạn vừa nói hoặc làm

senses.definition: to create particular conditions that exist in real life using computers, models, etc., usually for study or training purposes

examples.x: Computer software can be used to simulate conditions on the seabed.
Role-playing is a useful way of simulating real-life situations.
The device simulates conditions in space quite closely.

senses.definition_vi: tạo ra các điều kiện cụ thể tồn tại trong cuộc sống thực bằng máy tính, mô hình, v.v., thường cho mục đích nghiên cứu hoặc đào tạo

senses.definition: to be made to look like something else

examples.x: a gas heater that simulates a coal fire

senses.definition_vi: được làm cho trông giống như thứ khác

senses.definition: to pretend that you have a particular feeling

examples.x: I tried to simulate surprise at the news.

senses.definition_vi: giả vờ có một cảm xúc cụ thể

senses.definition: a situation in which a particular set of conditions is created artificially in order to study or experience something that could exist in reality

examples.x: a computer simulation of how the planet functions
a simulation model
An important part of training is role-play and the simulation of court cases.

senses.definition_vi: một tình huống mà một bộ điều kiện cụ thể được tạo ra một cách nhân tạo để nghiên cứu hoặc trải nghiệm một điều gì đó có thể tồn tại trong thực tế

senses.definition: the act of pretending that something is real when it is not

examples.x: the simulation of concern

senses.definition_vi: hành động giả vờ một điều gì đó là thật khi nó không phải vậy

senses.definition: at the same time as something else

examples.x: The game will be broadcast simultaneously on TV and radio.
The slowdown of the US economy occurred simultaneously with a downturn in Europe.

senses.definition_vi: cùng lúc với điều gì đó khác

senses.definition: an offence against God or against a religious or moral law

examples.x: to commit a sin
Confess your sins to God and he will forgive you.
God forgives our sins.
The Bible says that stealing is a sin.

senses.definition_vi: một sự xúc phạm chống lại Chúa hoặc chống lại một luật lệ tôn giáo hoặc đạo đức

senses.definition: the act of breaking a religious or moral law

examples.x: a life of sin
Believers are called on to turn away from sin and embrace a life of prayer.

senses.definition_vi: hành động vi phạm luật tôn giáo hoặc đạo đức

senses.definition: an action that people think is very bad

examples.x: It's a sin to waste taxpayers' money like that.

senses.definition_vi: một hành động mà mọi người cho là rất tệ

senses.definition: used to say that something that somebody does is like a punishment

examples.x: She works with us in Accounts, for her sins!

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó mà ai đó làm giống như một sự trừng phạt

senses.definition: to hide the real situation or facts when these are not good or pleasant

examples.x: It's a shabby old sofa but cushions and throws can hide a multitude of sins.

senses.definition_vi: che giấu tình hình hoặc sự thật thực tế khi chúng không tốt hoặc dễ chịu

senses.definition: to live together and have a sexual relationship without being married
senses.definition_vi: sống chung và có quan hệ tình dục mà không kết hôn

senses.definition: used to emphasize that somebody is very unhappy or ugly
senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng ai đó rất không hạnh phúc hoặc xấu xí

senses.definition: from a time in the past until a later past time, or until now

examples.x: She went for a run on Monday and has not been seen since.
She moved to Pakistan in 1997 and has been living in Lahore ever since.
He left home two weeks ago and we haven't heard from him since.
The health of the British people was better at the end of the Second World War than at any time before or since.
The original building has long since (= long before now) been demolished.

senses.definition_vi: từ một thời điểm trong quá khứ cho đến một thời điểm sau đó trong quá khứ, hoặc cho đến bây giờ

senses.definition: at a time after a particular time in the past

examples.x: The song topped the charts in 1957 and has since become a rock and roll classic.
We were divorced two years ago and she has since remarried.

senses.definition_vi: vào một thời điểm sau một thời điểm cụ thể trong quá khứ

senses.definition: from an event in the past until a later past event, or until now

examples.x: Cath hasn't phoned since she went to Berlin.
It was the first time I'd had visitors since I'd moved to London.
It's twenty years since I've seen her.
How long is it since we last went to the theatre?
She had been worrying ever since the letter arrived.

senses.definition_vi: từ một sự kiện trong quá khứ cho đến một sự kiện sau đó trong quá khứ, hoặc cho đến bây giờ

senses.definition: because; as

examples.x: We thought that, since we were in the area, we'd stop by and see them.

senses.definition_vi: bởi vì; vì

senses.definition: from a time in the past until a later past time, or until now

examples.x: She's been off work since Tuesday.
We've lived here since 2006.
I haven't eaten since breakfast.
He's been working in a bank since leaving school.
Since the party she had only spoken to him once.
‘They've split up.’ ‘Since when?’
That was years ago. I've changed jobs since then.

senses.definition_vi: từ một thời điểm trong quá khứ cho đến một thời điểm sau đó trong quá khứ, hoặc cho đến bây giờ

senses.definition: used when you are showing that you are angry about something

examples.x: Since when did he ever listen to me?

senses.definition_vi: được dùng khi bạn cho thấy bạn đang tức giận về điều gì đó

senses.definition: showing what you really think or feel

examples.x: a sincere apology
a sincere attempt to resolve the problem
sincere regret
Please accept our sincere thanks.
We offer our sincere sympathy to the two families.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện những gì bạn thực sự nghĩ hoặc cảm thấy

senses.definition: saying only what you really think or feel

examples.x: He seemed sincere enough when he said he wanted to help.
She is never completely sincere in what she says about people.
I think he is sincere in his desire to keep the economy growing.
his refusal to be sincere about his feelings

senses.definition_vi: chỉ nói những gì bạn thực sự nghĩ hoặc cảm thấy

senses.definition: an act of singing

examples.x: Let's have a sing.

senses.definition_vi: một hành động hát

senses.definition: a person who sings, or whose job is singing, especially in public

examples.x: She's a wonderful singer.
a pop/country/folk singer
He trained as an opera singer.
the band's lead singer
a singer in a German rock band
a singer of classical Javanese songs
She became a singer with various local bands.
His main ambition is to become a singer songwriter.

senses.definition_vi: một người hát, hoặc có nghề nghiệp là hát, đặc biệt là trước công chúng

senses.definition: the activity of making musical sounds with your voice

examples.x: the beautiful singing of birds
the singing of hymns/songs/carols
choral singing
There was singing and dancing all night.
a singing teacher
She has a beautiful singing voice.
The sound of singing came from the kitchen.

senses.definition_vi: hoạt động tạo ra âm thanh âm nhạc bằng giọng nói của bạn

senses.definition: only one

examples.x: He sent her a single red rose.
a single-sex school (= for boys only or for girls only)
All these jobs can now be done by one single machine.
We won by a single point.
They cloned a lamb from a single cell taken from an adult sheep.
the European single currency, the euro
a single honours degree (= for which you study only one subject)
It was the work of a single individual.
The statue was carved out of a single piece of wood.
You can switch between the single-player and the multiplayer games.

senses.definition_vi: chỉ một

senses.definition: intended to be used by only one person

examples.x: a single room
The jail housed 860 prisoners in single cells.
a single sheet (= large enough for a single bed)

senses.definition_vi: dùng cho một người

senses.definition: not married or having a romantic relationship with somebody

examples.x: a single person/woman/man
The apartments are ideal for single people living alone.
Are you still single?
She remained single till her death.
Young people are staying single for longer.
The film stars Bening as a single mother with a teenage son.
I'm a single father and take my kids to school every morning.

senses.definition_vi: không kết hôn hoặc không có mối quan hệ lãng mạn với ai đó

senses.definition: a single ticket, etc. can be used for travelling to a place but not back again

examples.x: a single ticket
How much is the single fare to Glasgow?

senses.definition_vi: vé một chiều, v.v. có thể được sử dụng để đi đến một địa điểm nhưng không quay trở lại

senses.definition: used to emphasize that you are referring to one particular person or thing on its own

examples.x: Unemployment is the single most important factor in the growing crime rates.
We eat rice every single day.
Every single one of her so-called friends had turned their backs on her.
I couldn't understand a single word she said!

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn đang đề cập đến một người hoặc một vật cụ thể một mình

senses.definition: immediately; with only a quick look

examples.x: She is able to take in complex information at a single glance.

senses.definition_vi: ngay lập tức; chỉ với một cái nhìn nhanh

senses.definition: in one single attempt or try

examples.x: She blew out the candles in a single go.

senses.definition_vi: trong một lần thử hoặc nỗ lực duy nhất

senses.definition: (in) one line, one behind the other

examples.x: They made their way in single file along the cliff path.

senses.definition_vi: theo một hàng, nối đuôi nhau

senses.definition: a ticket that allows you to travel to a place but not back again

examples.x: How much is a single to York?
I got a single to Birmingham.

senses.definition_vi: một vé cho phép bạn đi đến một địa điểm nhưng không quay trở lại

senses.definition: a room in a hotel, etc. for one person

examples.x: Singles are available from £50 per night.

senses.definition_vi: một căn phòng trong khách sạn, v.v. dành cho một người

senses.definition: people who are not married and do not have a romantic relationship with somebody else

examples.x: They organize parties for singles.
a singles bar/club

senses.definition_vi: những người không kết hôn và không có mối quan hệ lãng mạn với người khác

senses.definition: a piece of recorded music, usually popular music, that consists of one song; a CD that a single is recorded on

examples.x: The band releases its new single next week.
The band has yet to record a hit single.
Her catchy debut single was a hit.
This is a single from their album ‘Magic’.

senses.definition_vi: một bản nhạc thu âm, thường là nhạc phổ biến, bao gồm một bài hát; một đĩa CD có bản thu âm một đĩa đơn

senses.definition: a note that is worth one dollar
senses.definition_vi: một tờ tiền có giá trị một đô la

senses.definition: a game when only one player plays against one other; a series of two or more of these games

examples.x: the women’s singles champion
the first round of the men’s singles
a singles match
She's won three singles titles this year.
Singles is/are more popular with spectators.

senses.definition_vi: một trận đấu khi chỉ có một người chơi đấu với một người chơi khác; một loạt hai hoặc nhiều trận đấu như vậy

senses.definition: a hit from which a player scores one run (= point)
senses.definition_vi: một cú đánh mà người chơi ghi được một điểm chạy (= điểm)

senses.definition: a hit that only allows the player to run to first base
senses.definition_vi: một cú đánh chỉ cho phép người chơi chạy đến gôn thứ nhất

senses.definition: to go down below the surface or towards the bottom of a liquid or soft substance

examples.x: The ship sank to the bottom of the sea.
The submarine sank after an explosion.
We're sinking!
The wheels started to sink into the mud.
The little boat sank beneath the waves.

senses.definition_vi: đi xuống dưới bề mặt hoặc xuống đáy của chất lỏng hoặc chất mềm

senses.definition: to damage a boat or ship so that it goes below the surface of the sea, etc.

examples.x: The battleship was sunk by a torpedo.
Bombs sank all four carriers.
Five brothers all died when their ship was sunk.

senses.definition_vi: làm hư hại một chiếc thuyền hoặc tàu để nó chìm xuống dưới mặt biển, v.v.

senses.definition: to move downwards, especially by falling or sitting down

examples.x: I sank into an armchair.
She sank back into her seat, exhausted.
The old man had sunk to his knees.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển xuống dưới, đặc biệt là bằng cách ngã hoặc ngồi xuống

senses.definition: to move slowly downwards

examples.x: The sun was sinking in the west.
The sun had sunk below the horizon.
The foundations of the building are starting to sink.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển xuống dưới chậm

senses.definition: to decrease in amount, volume, strength, etc.

examples.x: The pound has sunk to its lowest recorded level against the dollar.
He is clearly sinking fast (= getting weaker quickly and will soon die).

senses.definition_vi: giảm về số lượng, khối lượng, sức mạnh, v.v.

senses.definition: to become quieter

examples.x: Her voice sank to a whisper.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên yên tĩnh hơn

senses.definition: to make a deep hole in the ground

examples.x: to sink a well/shaft/mine

senses.definition_vi: tạo một lỗ sâu trên mặt đất

senses.definition: to place something in the ground by digging

examples.x: to sink a post into the ground

senses.definition_vi: đặt một cái gì đó vào lòng đất bằng cách đào

senses.definition: to prevent somebody or somebody’s plans from succeeding

examples.x: I think I've just sunk my chances of getting the job.
If the car breaks down, we'll be sunk (= have serious problems).

senses.definition_vi: ngăn cản ai đó hoặc kế hoạch của ai đó thành công

senses.definition: to hit a ball into a hole in golf or snooker

examples.x: He sank a 12-foot putt to win the match.

senses.definition_vi: đánh một quả bóng vào lỗ trong môn golf hoặc bi-a

senses.definition: to drink something quickly, especially a large amount of alcohol

examples.x: They sank three pints each in 10 minutes.

senses.definition_vi: uống nhanh một thứ gì đó, đặc biệt là một lượng lớn rượu

senses.definition: to be in a state of unhappiness or deep thought

examples.x: She just sat there, sunk in thought.

senses.definition_vi: ở trong trạng thái buồn bã hoặc suy tư sâu sắc

senses.definition: used to talk about people who leave an organization, a company, etc. that is having difficulties, without caring about the people who are left
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói về những người rời bỏ một tổ chức, một công ty, v.v. đang gặp khó khăn, mà không quan tâm đến những người còn lại

senses.definition: used to say that somebody suddenly feels sad or depressed about something

examples.x: My heart sank when I saw how much work there was left.
She watched him go with a sinking heart.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng ai đó đột nhiên cảm thấy buồn hoặc chán nản về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to agree to forget about your disagreements

examples.x: We need to sink our differences and present a united opposition to the plan.

senses.definition_vi: đồng ý quên đi những bất đồng của bạn

senses.definition: an unpleasant feeling that you get when you realize that something bad has happened or is going to happen

examples.x: I had a horrible sinking feeling when I saw the ambulance outside the house.

senses.definition_vi: một cảm giác khó chịu mà bạn có khi nhận ra rằng điều gì đó tồi tệ đã xảy ra hoặc sắp xảy ra

senses.definition: to be in a situation where you will either succeed by your own efforts or fail completely

senses.definition_vi: đột nhiên không thể kiểm soát cảm xúc của mình nữa vì tình huống trở nên quá khó khăn

senses.definition: to fasten a piece of clothing with a snap
senses.definition_vi: cài một món quần áo bằng nút bấm

senses.definition: to start play by passing the ball back between your legs

examples.x: Time will not be resumed until the ball is snapped on the next play.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu trận đấu bằng cách chuyền bóng về giữa hai chân

senses.definition: to shout at somebody in an angry way, especially without reason
senses.definition_vi: hét vào ai đó một cách giận dữ, đặc biệt là không có lý do

senses.definition: to make a sharp noise by moving your second or third finger quickly against your thumb, to attract somebody’s attention, or to mark the beat of music, for example

examples.x: He snapped his fingers for the waiter.
She only has to snap her fingers and her assistant comes running.

senses.definition_vi: tạo ra một tiếng động sắc nét bằng cách di chuyển ngón thứ hai hoặc thứ ba của bạn nhanh chóng vào ngón cái, để thu hút sự chú ý của ai đó, hoặc để đánh dấu nhịp điệu của âm nhạc, chẳng hạn

senses.definition: to make an effort to stop feeling unhappy or depressed; to help somebody to stop feeling unhappy

examples.x: You've been depressed for weeks. It's time you snapped out of it.

senses.definition_vi: nỗ lực để ngừng cảm thấy không vui hoặc chán nản; giúp ai đó ngừng cảm thấy không vui

senses.definition: used, especially in orders, to tell somebody to start working harder or more quickly
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng, đặc biệt là trong các mệnh lệnh, để yêu cầu ai đó bắt đầu làm việc chăm chỉ hơn hoặc nhanh hơn

senses.definition: small soft white pieces (called flakes) of frozen water that fall from the sky in cold weather; this substance when it is lying on the ground

examples.x: Snow was falling heavily.
We had snow in May this year.
The snow was beginning to melt.
Heavy snow is expected tomorrow.
Children were playing in the snow.
She saw them trudging through the snow towards the house.
We got over 100 inches of snow last winter.
There was almost a foot of snow on the ground.
20 cm of snow were expected today.
The snow didn't settle (= stay on the ground).
The snow and ice caused a number of traffic accidents.
Last week's cold temperatures were accompanied by rain and snow.
Her skin was as white as snow.

senses.definition_vi: những mẩu nhỏ màu trắng mềm mại (gọi là bông tuyết) của nước đóng băng rơi từ trên trời xuống trong thời tiết lạnh; chất này khi nằm trên mặt đất

senses.definition: an amount of snow that falls in one particular place or at one particular time

examples.x: the first snows of winter
the snows of Mount Kilimanjaro

senses.definition_vi: một lượng tuyết rơi xuống ở một địa điểm hoặc thời điểm cụ thể

senses.definition: extremely clean, pure, etc.
senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ sạch sẽ, tinh khiết, v.v.

senses.definition: when it snows, snow falls from the sky

examples.x: It's been snowing heavily all day.
It snowed for three days without stopping.
It was still snowing outside.

senses.definition_vi: khi tuyết rơi, tuyết rơi từ trên trời xuống

senses.definition: to impress somebody a lot by the things you say, especially if these are not true or not sincere

examples.x: He really snowed me with all his talk of buying a Porsche.

senses.definition_vi: gây ấn tượng mạnh với ai đó bằng những điều bạn nói, đặc biệt nếu những điều đó không đúng hoặc không chân thành

senses.definition: to be unable to leave a place because of heavy snow

examples.x: We were snowed in for two days.

senses.definition_vi: không thể rời khỏi một nơi do tuyết rơi dày

senses.definition: to have more things, especially work, than you feel able to deal with

examples.x: I'd love to come but I'm completely snowed under at the moment.

senses.definition_vi: có nhiều thứ, đặc biệt là công việc, hơn mức bạn có thể xử lý

senses.definition: to be blocked with snow
senses.definition_vi: bị chặn bởi tuyết

senses.definition: to such a great degree

examples.x: Don't look so angry.
There's no need to worry so.
Why has it taken so long?
That wasn't so bad, was it?
She spoke so quietly (that) I could hardly hear her.
What is it that's so important it can't wait five minutes?
He was so impressed that he jumped up and down with excitement.
She gets so caught up in her fame that she neglects her true friends.
It was so incredibly cheap it was unbelievable.
I'm not so stupid as to believe that.
Would you be so kind as to lock the door when you leave?

senses.definition_vi: ở mức độ lớn như vậy

senses.definition: very; extremely

examples.x: I'm so glad to see you.
The girls looked so pretty in their summer dresses.
I was pleased that so many people turned up.
We have so much to do.
It's so good to have you back.
We've worked so hard to get to this point.
They came so close to winning.
You're going to Harvard! That's so great!
Their attitude is so very English.
The article was just so much (= nothing but) nonsense.
I am so pleased with this new book.
He sat there ever so quietly.
I do love it so.

senses.definition_vi: rất; cực kỳ

senses.definition: not to the same degree

examples.x: I haven't enjoyed myself so much for a long time.
I have never felt so humiliated in my entire life.
It wasn't so good as last time.
It's not so easy as you'd think.
He was not so quick a learner as his brother.
It's not so much a hobby as a career (= more like a career than a hobby).
Off she went without so much as (= without even) a ‘goodbye’.

senses.definition_vi: không ở cùng mức độ

senses.definition: used to show the size, amount or number of something

examples.x: The fish was about so big (= said when using your hands to show the size).
There are only so many (= only a limited number of) hours in a day.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ kích thước, số lượng hoặc số lượng của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: used to refer back to something that has already been mentioned

examples.x: ‘Is he coming?’ ‘I hope so.’
‘Did they mind?’ ‘I don't think so.’
If she notices, she never says so.
I might be away next week. If so, I won't be able to see you.
We are very busy—so much so that we won't be able to take time off this year.
Programs are expensive, and even more so if you have to keep altering them.
I hear that you're a writer—is that so (= is that true)?
George is going to help me, or so he says (= that is what he says but I am not sure if I believe him).
They asked me to call them and I did so (= I called).
She leaked the story to the media and, in so doing, helped bring down the president.
He thinks I dislike him but that just isn't so.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đề cập lại một điều gì đó đã được đề cập trước đó

senses.definition: also

examples.x: Times have changed and so have I.
‘I prefer the first version.’ ‘So do we.’
Temperatures are rising in Canada, and so too are the annual blueberry harvests.

senses.definition_vi: cũng vậy

senses.definition: used to agree that something is true, especially when you are surprised

examples.x: ‘You were there, too.’ ‘So I was—I'd forgotten.’
‘There's another one.’ ‘So there is.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đồng ý rằng điều gì đó là đúng, đặc biệt là khi bạn ngạc nhiên

senses.definition: used, often with a negative, before adjectives and noun phrases to emphasize something that you are saying

examples.x: He is so not the right person for you.
That is so not cool.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng, thường với phủ định, trước tính từ và cụm danh từ để nhấn mạnh điều gì đó bạn đang nói

senses.definition: used, especially by children, to say that what somebody says is not the case and the opposite is true

examples.x: ‘You're not telling the truth, are you?’ ‘I am, so!’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng, đặc biệt là bởi trẻ em, để nói rằng những gì ai đó nói là không đúng và điều ngược lại mới là đúng

senses.definition: used when you are showing somebody how to do something or telling them how something happened

examples.x: Stand with your arms out, so.
So it was that he finally returned home.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang chỉ cho ai đó cách làm điều gì đó hoặc nói cho họ biết điều gì đó đã xảy ra như thế nào

senses.definition: used at the end of a list to show that it continues in the same way

examples.x: We discussed everything—when to go, what to see and so on.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng ở cuối danh sách để cho thấy nó tiếp tục theo cùng một cách

senses.definition: used to give an important extra reason why something is true

examples.x: His achievement is remarkable; all the more so because he had no help at all.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đưa ra một lý do bổ sung quan trọng tại sao điều gì đó đúng

senses.definition: used after a number, an amount, etc. to show that it is not exact

examples.x: There were twenty or so (= about twenty) people there.
We stayed for an hour or so.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng sau một con số, một lượng, v.v. để cho thấy rằng nó không chính xác

senses.definition: with the intention of doing something

examples.x: We went early so as to get good seats.

senses.definition_vi: với ý định làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to show that you accept something and will not try to change it or cannot change it

examples.x: If he doesn't want to be involved, then so be it.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy bạn chấp nhận điều gì đó và sẽ không cố gắng thay đổi nó hoặc không thể thay đổi nó

senses.definition: used to show that you have finished talking about something

examples.x: So much for the situation in Germany. Now we turn our attention to France.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy bạn đã kết thúc việc nói về điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to suggest that something has not been successful or useful

examples.x: So much for that idea!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy rằng điều gì đó đã không thành công hoặc vô ích

senses.definition: in such a way that

examples.x: The programme has been so organized that none of the talks overlap.

senses.definition_vi: theo cách mà

senses.definition: used to show the reason for something

examples.x: It was still painful, so I went to see a doctor.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy lý do của điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to show the purpose of something

examples.x: But I gave you a map so you wouldn't get lost!
She worked hard so that everything would be ready in time.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy mục đích của điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to show the result of something

examples.x: Nothing more was heard from him so that we began to wonder if he was dead.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy kết quả của điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to introduce a comment or a question

examples.x: So, let's see. What do we need to take?
So, what have you been doing today?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu một nhận xét hoặc một câu hỏi

senses.definition: used to introduce the next part of a story

examples.x: So after shouting and screaming for an hour she walked out in tears.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu phần tiếp theo của một câu chuyện

senses.definition: used to show that you think something is not important, especially after somebody has criticized you for it

examples.x: So I had a couple of drinks on the way home. What's wrong with that?
‘You've been smoking again.’ ‘So?’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy bạn nghĩ điều gì đó không quan trọng, đặc biệt là sau khi ai đó đã chỉ trích bạn vì điều đó

senses.definition: used when you are making a final statement

examples.x: So, that's it for today.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi đưa ra một tuyên bố cuối cùng

senses.definition: used in questions to refer to something that has just been said

examples.x: So there's nothing we can do about it?
‘I've just got back from a trip to Rome.’ ‘So, how was it?’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong các câu hỏi để đề cập đến một điều vừa được nói

senses.definition: used to introduce an answer to a question, an explanation or a statement

examples.x: So, I've been working on a new project.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu một câu trả lời cho một câu hỏi, một lời giải thích hoặc một tuyên bố

senses.definition: used when stating that two events, situations, etc. are similar

examples.x: Just as large companies are having to cut back, so small businesses are being forced to close.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy bạn nghĩ rằng hai sự kiện, tình huống, v.v. là tương tự nhau

senses.definition: used to show that you think something is not important, especially after somebody has criticized you for it

examples.x: ‘He's fifteen years younger than you!’ ‘So what?’
So what if nobody else agrees with me?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy bạn nghĩ điều gì đó không quan trọng, đặc biệt là sau khi ai đó đã chỉ trích bạn vì điều đó

senses.definition: to put something in liquid for a time so that it becomes completely wet; to become completely wet in this way

examples.x: I usually soak the beans overnight.
If you soak the tablecloth before you wash it, the stains should come out.
He soaked the cloth with petrol.
Leave the apricots to soak for 20 minutes.
I'm going to go and soak in the bath.
Soak the clothes in cold water.

senses.definition_vi: để đặt một thứ gì đó vào chất lỏng trong một thời gian để nó bị ướt hoàn toàn; để bị ướt hoàn toàn theo cách này

senses.definition: to make somebody/something completely wet

examples.x: A sudden shower of rain soaked the spectators.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó/thứ gì đó bị ướt hoàn toàn

senses.definition: to enter or pass through something

examples.x: Blood had soaked through the bandage.
The rain had soaked through every layer of his clothing.
Water dripped off the table and soaked into the carpet.

senses.definition_vi: đi vào hoặc đi qua một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to obtain a lot of money from somebody by making them pay very high taxes or prices

examples.x: He was accused of soaking his clients.

senses.definition_vi: để lấy rất nhiều tiền từ ai đó bằng cách bắt họ trả thuế hoặc giá rất cao

senses.definition: a substance that you use with water for washing your body

examples.x: Wash the affected area with soap and water.
a bar/cake of soap
soap bubbles
a soap dish
Avoid using perfumed soaps on sensitive skin.

senses.definition_vi: một chất bạn sử dụng với nước để rửa cơ thể

senses.definition: a soap opera (= a story about the lives and problems of a group of people that is broadcast every day or several times a week on television or radio)

examples.x: soaps on TV
She's a US soap star.

senses.definition_vi: một vở opera xà phòng (= một câu chuyện về cuộc sống và vấn đề của một nhóm người được phát sóng hàng ngày hoặc nhiều lần một tuần trên truyền hình hoặc radio)

senses.definition: if the value, amount or level of something soars, it rises very quickly

examples.x: soaring costs/prices/temperatures
Air pollution will soon soar above safety levels.
Unemployment has soared to 18 per cent.

senses.definition_vi: nếu giá trị, số lượng hoặc mức độ của một thứ gì đó tăng vọt, nó sẽ tăng rất nhanh

senses.definition: to rise quickly and smoothly up into the air

examples.x: The rocket soared (up) into the air.
Her spirits soared (= she became very happy and excited).

senses.definition_vi: bay lên nhanh chóng và mượt mà vào không khí

senses.definition: to fly very high in the air or remain high in the air

examples.x: an eagle soaring high above the cliffs

senses.definition_vi: bay rất cao trong không khí hoặc ở trên cao trong không khí

senses.definition: to be very high or tall

examples.x: soaring mountains
The building soared above us.
The cliffs soared upward.

senses.definition_vi: khi âm nhạc cao vút, nó trở nên cao hơn hoặc to hơn

senses.definition: when music soars, it becomes higher or louder

examples.x: soaring strings
Her voice would soar over the orchestra with little effort.

senses.definition_vi: rất cao hoặc dài

senses.definition: a game played by two teams of 11 players, using a round ball which players kick up and down the playing field. Teams try to kick the ball into the other team’s goal.

examples.x: I played soccer when I was younger.
a soccer team/club/player/fan
a soccer match/game
a soccer field
a soccer pitch/stadium
They were watching a game of soccer on TV.

senses.definition_vi: một trò chơi được chơi bởi hai đội gồm 11 người, sử dụng một quả bóng tròn mà người chơi đá lên xuống sân. Các đội cố gắng đá bóng vào khung thành của đối phương.

senses.definition: connected with activities in which people meet each other for pleasure

examples.x: She has a busy social life.
Team sports help to develop a child's social skills (= the ability to talk easily to other people and do things in a group).
Social events and training days are arranged for all the staff.
Join a social club to make new friends.
It was a purely social visit.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến các hoạt động mà mọi người gặp gỡ nhau để giải trí

senses.definition: connected with society and the way it is organized

examples.x: The film addresses serious social issues.
The area has major social problems such as drug abuse and poverty.
It was a period of political upheaval and social change.
He fought for social justice and civil rights.
the social welfare system
the country's economic and social development

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến xã hội và cách nó được tổ chức

senses.definition: connected with your position in society

examples.x: Income differences between social classes are widening.
A major influence on health is social status.
social advancement (= improving your position in society)
social mobility (= the movement of people from one social class to another)

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến vị trí của bạn trong xã hội

senses.definition: living naturally in groups, rather than alone

examples.x: Apes are social animals.

senses.definition_vi: sống tự nhiên theo nhóm, thay vì một mình

senses.definition: enjoying spending time with other people
senses.definition_vi: thích dành thời gian với người khác

senses.definition: connected with socialism

examples.x: socialist beliefs

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến chủ nghĩa xã hội

senses.definition: governed by or belonging to a party that believes in socialism

examples.x: a socialist country
the ruling Socialist Party

senses.short_meaning_vi: chính phủ xã hội chủ nghĩa
senses.definition_vi: được cai trị bởi hoặc thuộc về một đảng tin vào chủ nghĩa xã hội

senses.definition: people in general, living together in communities

examples.x: She believes that the arts benefit society as a whole.
Racism exists at all levels of society.
These children have grown up to be useful and productive members of society.
Every section of society must have access to education.
They carried out research into the roles of men and women in today’s society.

senses.definition_vi: mọi người nói chung, sống cùng nhau trong các cộng đồng

senses.definition: a particular community of people who share the same customs, laws, etc.

examples.x: modern industrial societies
demand created by a consumer society
Can Britain ever be a classless society?
They were discussing the problems of Western society.
We live in a society that is obsessed with how people look.
These rights are necessary in a democratic society.

senses.definition_vi: một cộng đồng cụ thể của những người có cùng phong tục, luật pháp, v.v.

senses.definition: a group of people who join together for a particular purpose

examples.x: a member of the drama society
the American Society of Newspaper Editors
I joined the local Genealogy Society.

senses.definition_vi: một nhóm người tham gia cùng nhau vì một mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition: the group of people in a country who are fashionable, rich and powerful

examples.x: Their daughter married into high society.
a society wedding

senses.definition_vi: nhóm người trong một quốc gia có thời trang, giàu có và quyền lực

senses.definition: the state of being with other people

examples.x: He was a solitary man who avoided the society of others.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái ở cùng với người khác

senses.definition: a piece of clothing that is worn over the foot, ankle and lower part of the leg, especially inside a shoe

examples.x: a pair of socks
I never wear socks.
He had odd socks on, one red and one yellow.

senses.definition_vi: một món đồ để đi vào bàn chân, mắt cá chân và phần dưới của chân, đặc biệt là bên trong giày

senses.definition: a hard hit, especially with the fist

examples.x: He gave him a sock on the jaw.

senses.definition_vi: một cú đánh mạnh, đặc biệt là bằng nắm đấm

senses.definition: to surprise or impress somebody very much
senses.definition_vi: làm ai đó ngạc nhiên hoặc gây ấn tượng rất mạnh

senses.definition: to try to improve your performance, work, behaviour, etc.

examples.x: You're going to have to pull your socks up.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng cải thiện hiệu suất, công việc, hành vi của bạn, v.v.

senses.definition: used to tell somebody to stop talking or making a noise

examples.x: Can't you put a sock in it? I'm trying to work.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để bảo ai đó ngừng nói hoặc tạo ra tiếng động

senses.definition: changing shape easily when pressed; not stiff or hard

examples.x: soft margarine
soft feather pillows
The grass was soft and springy.
They lay down on the soft sand.
These tomatoes have gone all soft.
The ground was soft and dry.
When the onion becomes soft, season with salt and pepper.

senses.definition_vi: dễ thay đổi hình dạng khi bị ép; không cứng

senses.definition: less hard than average

examples.x: soft rocks such as limestone
soft corals
soft cheeses
the soft palate

senses.definition_vi: ít cứng hơn mức trung bình

senses.definition: smooth and pleasant to touch

examples.x: soft skin
a dress made from the finest, softest silk
The fabric has a beautifully soft texture.
Clean the lens with a soft cloth.

senses.definition_vi: mịn và dễ chịu khi chạm vào

senses.definition: not having sharp angles or hard edges

examples.x: This season's fashions focus on warm tones and soft lines.
The moon's pale light cast soft shadows.

senses.definition: to do anything, even something really bad or dishonest, in return for money, success or power
senses.definition_vi: làm bất cứ điều gì, ngay cả những điều thực sự tồi tệ hoặc không trung thực, để đổi lấy tiền, thành công hoặc quyền lực

senses.definition_vi: hợp lý; đáng tin cậy và có khả năng mang lại kết quả tốt

senses.definition_vi: tốt, chi tiết và hoàn chỉnh

senses.definition_vi: trong tình trạng tốt; không bị hư hại, tổn thương, v.v.

senses.definition_vi: sâu lắng và yên bình

senses.definition_vi: nghiêm trọng
